properties.event_description: Two hundred police officers from the police force, cavalry and cannil and an elite battalion and helicopters and about a hundred private security manbred from the concrete company have violently moved the Indians.

properties.violence_context: In 9 / 11, the Tabajara retaken part of their traditional territory, where there was a settlement and some lots had been illegally sold to the concrete company "Elizabeth Ceramic." On the 30th, the police operation for the area's unemployment surprised the Indians. Attempts at dialogue with the government and Funai were in vain.

properties.event_description: Journalist Claudio Humberto used the term "Indian Pilantra wants money." In his words, "The married governor and the greatest flood of Roraima's history, a public calamity, are not enough: the Indians of the San Marcos Reserve prevented an engineering company from recovering the BR-174 North's course at Paracaima. Indian pylantra wants money: only free access after" negotiating "with the state government. They face the PM and PF, placing families before machines."
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: El periodista Claudio Humberto usó la expresión "Indio pilantra quiere dinero". En sus palabras: "No basta el gobernador casado y la mayor inundación de la historia de Roraima, una calamidad pública: los indios de la Reserva San Marcos impidieron que una empresa de ingeniería recuperase el trecho de la BR-174 Norte en Paracaima. Indio pilantra quiere dinero: sólo libera el acceso después de 'negociar' con el gobierno estatal. Hacen frente al MP y la PF, colocando a las familias ante las máquinas".

properties.event_description: The indigenous leaders report threats from Commander Alves of the Environmental Police. He orders people passing by the police station to submit personal document to see if they are indigenous. According to the Indians, he stated that he was at his place to "exterminate that flock of indigenous people that exist there and that he went that way to terrorize that flock of despondent Indians and that nobody would stop him."
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Las líderesas indígenas denuncian amenazas por parte del comandante Alves de la Policía Ambiental. Él ordena a personas que pasan delante de la comisaría para presentar documento personal para ver si es indígena. Según los indios, él afirmó que estaba en el lugar para "exterminar aquella bandada de indígenas que existen por allí y que fue para allá para aterrorizar a esa bandada de indios miserables y que nadie lo detendría".
properties.violence_context: On the night of September 5, police surrounded their homes and heard an argument. In the morning, she awoke the family threatening to put them in jail. He brought his wife to the police station and forced her to lie that she had been beaten by her husband. The woman denied and the police went to her husband's place of work, came to the police station and intimidated the indigenous woman to count if she would be taken to the Alta Flodesta chain. He later freed his wife and stayed with his husband and demanded that he dig a grave.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): En la noche del 5 de septiembre, el policía rondó las casas de los indígenas y escuchó una discusión. En la mañana, despertó a la familia amenazando con llevarlos presos. Llevó a la mujer a la comisaría y la obligó a mentir que había sido golpeada por su marido. La mujer negó y el policía fue al lugar de trabajo de su marido, llegó hasta la comisaría e intimidó a la indígena para que ella contara si sería llevada a la cadena de Alta Floresta. Luego liberó a la mujer y se quedó con su marido exigiendo que él cavara una fosa.

properties.event_description: According to Davi Kopenawa of the HAY association, the conflict that caused the death of four people was motivated by a dispute about a camp.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Según Davi Kopenawa, de la asociación HAY, el conflicto que causó la muerte de cuatro personas fue motivado por la disputa por un campo.
properties.violence_context: Although conflicts have already occurred among the Indians, earlier arms have been embroidery and arrow. According to Funai, Indians are being armed by miners in exchange for permits for illegal gold production in indigenous territory, which would be invaded by at least 1,600 men. In 2012, PF retreated about 600 miners from the region but many returned. To the head of the Yanomami protection sector at Funai, the conflict was very serious for involving a newly contacted group.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Aunque ya ocurrían conflictos entre los indios, antes las armas eran bordunas y flechas. Según la Funai, los indios están siendo armados por mineros a cambio de permisos para explotación ilegal de oro en el territorio indígena, que estaría invadido por al menos 1.600 hombres. En 2012, la PF llegó a retirar cerca de 600 mineros de la región, pero muchos regresaron. Para el jefe del sector de protección Yanomami de la Funai, el conflicto fue gravísimo por involucrar a un grupo recién contactado.

properties.event_description: The indigenous man was killed on his neighbor's path to the Mendes Júnior road, which gives them access to South Amazon. The victim had been suffering death threats from the invaders of indigenous lands.

properties.violence_context: The constant invasions for illegal mining, mining and cattle production reach several villages such as the Surui, Cocoa region, Cinta Larga at Espicão D'Oeste and now the Kaxarari at the Ponta do Abunã.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Las constantes invasiones para la extracción ilegal de madera, el robo de minerales y la cría de ganado alcanzan a varios pueblos como los Surui, región de Cacoal, Cinta Larga en Espigão D'Oeste y ahora los Kaxarari en la Ponta do Abunã.

properties.event_description: Ronaldo accompanied his father, Luiz Vicente, who was his guide to the miners. They were leading a group of 5 miners who wanted to explore the heart of the Yanomami Earth. Upon his arrival at a particular point, Luiz and Ronaldo said they would have been moved forward. The miners did not accept and fired shots at Ronaldo and his father, who died at the place. Ronaldo was wounded with a gunshot to his shoulder, and his death was faked and his father fled. In March that year, police custody was ordered for miners.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Ronaldo acompañaba a su padre, Luiz Vicente, que era guía de los mineros. Estaban guiando a un grupo de 5 mineros que quería explorar el corazón de la Tierra Yanomami. Al llegar en un determinado punto, Luiz y Ronaldo dijeron que no seguirían adelante. Los mineros no aceptaron y dispararon tiros contra Ronaldo y su padre, quien murió en el lugar. Ronaldo fue herido con un disparo en el hombro, fingió su muerte y luego huyó. En marzo de ese año, se decretó prisión preventiva para los mineros.

properties.violence_context: The threats and pressures on land use have been occurring 11 years ago at Lake Marahã's Paulari IT by people who are no longer living in the area and are only temporarily attending to exploit the regional resources. They withdraw wood into indigenous territory without any restrictions, invade rivers to fish and illegally withdraw turtles, among other illicit activities.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Las amenazas y presiones sobre el uso de la tierra vienen ocurriendo hace once años en la TI Paumari del Lago Marahã por poseedores que ya no habitan el área, sólo frecuentan temporalmente para explotar los recursos de la región. properties.event_description: The victim's body was found at MS-289, at the border that links Colonel Sapuacoa to Amamambai. According to Osvaldo's mother's testimony, the indigenous person was taken from his house by two non-indigenous men who forced him to date them. The police suggested that this was an accident, however, the shooting and knife sign marks on the victim, as well as the absence of fringes or even broken glass on the road, reveal that the indigenous man was killed.

La Policía sugirió que fue un accidente, si embargo, las marcas de tiros y señales de cuchillo en la víctima, además de ausencia de frenadas o incluso vidrios rotos en la carretera, develan que el indígena fue asesinado.
properties.violence_context: The community of Kurussu Ambá has been living at the border of Highway MS 289 since 2007, where children have no access to drinking water. They're under constant threat and they're targeted. In 2007, Jute and Ortiz Lopes leaders were killed. No investigation into the murders has been completed. A further five indigenous people from the community had bullets from their body as they were reached during an attack by members of private security against the group.

Otros cinco indígenas de la comunidad tenían cicatrices de heridas de balas por el cuerpo, pues fueron alcanzados durante un ataque de miembros de la seguridad privada contra el grupo.

A causa de este episodio el chamán, Cirilo y Lourenço Rupe están recibiendo amenazas.

To that end, the indigenous people had been afraid of the damage and had decided not to speak out against the work.

Ante ese escenario, los indígenas temieron los perjuicios y decidieron no pronunciarse contra la obra.

properties.defence_activity: The invaders' forest. The Awá-Guajá are one of Brazil's last hunting villages. Surrounded by great properties, cattle growers, logging and settlers, they have been trapped in their own land.
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): El bosque de los invasores. Los Awá-Guajá son unos de los últimos pueblos de cazadores-recolectores de Brasil. Rodeado de grandes propiedades, ganaderos, madereros y colonos, se han atrapado en su propia tierra.
properties.event_description: The indigenous person was assaulted and beaten by a logging man while hunting, with injuries in several parts of his body. Following an arrest by Funai of weapons from logging operations in the Indigenous Land, the indigenous people remained vulnerable and requested protection from Funai, which did not take appropriate measures. Kamayru had not registered an incident bulletin.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: El indígena fue agredido y golpeado por un maderero mientras cazaba, teniendo lesiones en varias partes del cuerpo. Después de que la Funai hizo una aprehensión de armas de los madereros que actuaban en la Tierra Indígena, los indígenas quedaron vulnerables y solicitaron protección de la Funai, que no tomó las medidas debidas. Kamayru no había registrado un boletín de incidencia.
properties.violence_context: The Awá-Guajá are threatened with extinction and have been cornered onto their own lands. Fingers hired by tiddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddA week earlier, the village had been invaded in retaliation by the prison of two "mateiros" (individuals that mark the trees to bring them down) by the operation of the Awá-Guajá Ethnic Protection Front, recently established by the Funai. The retaliation also involved violence against Kamairu.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Los Awá-Guajá están amenazados de extinción y vienen siendo acorralados en sus propias tierras. Pistoleros contratados por hacendados y madereros "cazan" a los indios que pasan por su camino. Una semana antes, la aldea había sido invadida en represalia por la prisión de dos "mateiros" (individuos que marcan los árboles para derribarlos) por la operación del Frente de Protección Etnoambiental Awá-Guajá, recientemente creada por la Funai. La represalia involucró también la violencia contra Kamairu.

properties.organization: Aldea Terrã-Wangã , Associação Da Resistência Indigena Arara Do Maia (Ariam)
properties.position: Indigenous cacique of the village and respressor of the Arama
properties.position (as given, Spanish): Cacique indígena de la aldea y respresentante de la ariam
properties.defence_activity: The historic and Xingu River of the construction of the mega-project of the Belo Monte hydropower user, at the hands of the group of companies North Energia. The Amazon river passes through territories with 17 indigenous ethnicity and the dam inevitably alters the course of the river, the environment and the way of living of communities around them. He also protested against how an undertaking was conducted, in an authoritative manner, without listening to the indigenous people.
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su terriotorio ancestral y el río Xingu de la construción del megaproyecto de la usina hidroeléctrica Belo Monte, a manos del grupo de empresas Norte Energia. El río amazónico pasa por territorios de 17 etnias indígenas y la represa altera de manera irreversible el curso del río, el medioambiente y la forma de vida de las comunidades en el entorno. Protestaba también contra la forma que el emprendimiento era conducido, de manera autoritaria, sin escuchar a los indígenas.
properties.event_description: With the physical demarcation of the indigenous territory, the threats became directed at José Carlos as a reference person from his village and as a defender of the Xingu River in his fight with Belo Monte. The leader became escorted by agents of the Federal police, more specifically by agents of the National Forces, as long as he was in the municipality of Altamira.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Con la demarcación física del territorio indígena, las amenazas pasaron a ser dirigidas a José Carlos, por ser persona de referencia de la aldea y defensor del río Xingu en la lucha contra Belo Monte. El lider pasó a vivir escoltado por agentes de la Policía Federal, más específicamente por agentes de la Fuerza Nacional, siempre que estaba en el municipio de Altamira.
properties.violence_context: His fight against the construction of Belo Monte is old. On July 22, 2009, José was with Ozimar Juruna and others at an audience with President Lula as they questioned and went against the construction of his office. The Funai's manager at Altamira later attempted to intimidate both indigenous people from raising their voices against UHE Belo Monte.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Su lucha contra la construcción de Belo Monte es antigua. El 22 de julio de 2009, José estuvo, junto a Ozimar Juruna y otros, en audiencia con el Presidente Lula cuando cuestionaron y se fueron contra la construcción de la usina. Luego, el administrador de la Funai en Altamira intentó intimidar a los dos indígenas a no levantar más la voz contra la UHE Belo Monte.

properties.event_description: The TV's Report Record program was broadcast a sensationalist report exposing internal conflicts with the people of Pankararu without necessary ground and deepening. The community suffers from serious difficulties as a result of the issue of land. The news criminalized cacique. The report incited prejudice and called into question the criteria of being Indian or non-Indian and denying cacique as leading. The cacique and his grandchildren have been chased as a result of this situation in the neighbouring cities of Pertrolândia and Tacaratu.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: El programa Report Record de la TV se transmitió un reportaje sensacionalista exponiendo conflictos internos del pueblo Pankararu sin fundamento y profundización necesarios. La comunidad pasa por serias dificultades debido a la cuestión de la tierra. La noticia criminalizaba al cacique. El reportaje incitó el prejuicio y cuestionó los criterios de ser o no indio y deslegitimando el cacique como lider. Como resultado de esta situación, el cacique y sus nietos sufrieron persecución en las ciudades vecinas de Pertrolândia y Tacaratu.

properties.event_description: Following the conduct of the protest called an Indigenous April and blockade of the BR-386 road, the media did photo and an interview with cacique Luiz Salvador. The netizens published prethought comments such as: "they wander around the cities" and "have to put 800 of these homeless and get through with the trucks." They accused the indigenous people of car theft. A complaint was made at the MFPM of Palmera de las Misiones.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: En consecuencia de la realización de la protesta denominada abril Indígena y bloqueo de la carretera BR-386, los medios de comunicación hicieron registro fotográfico y una entrevista con el cacique Luiz Salvador. Los internautas publicaron comentarios preconcebidos tales como: "se van vagando por las ciudades" y "tienen que poner 800 de esos vagabundos y pasar por encima con los camiones". Acusaban a los indígenas de robo de vehículos. Una denuncia fue realizada en el MPF de Palmera de las Misiones.
properties.violence_context: As part of the protest called Indigenous April throughout Brazil, communities from Rio de la Várzea, Iraqi and Goj Vêso blocked the BR-386 road in Iraqi. The main challenges were the demarcation of traditional lands and the rejection of the Unmanzo of Funai and the indications of confidence by politicians. Protests against the reforms put forward by the federal government were also an integral part of the indigenous people's leadership.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Como parte de la protesta denominada Abril Indígena, en todo Brasil, comunidades de Río de la Várzea, Iraí y Goj Vêso bloquearon la carretera BR-386, en Iraí. Las principales reivindicaciones eran la demarcación de las tierras tradicionales y el rechazo al desmanche de la Funai y a las indicaciones de cargos de confianza por políticos. Las protestas contra las reformas propuestas por el gobierno federal también formaban parte de la pauta de los indígenas.

Solamente en diciembre de 2011 entró en el programa de protección a Defensores de Derechos Humanos de la Presidencia de la República.
properties.violence_context: On 9 / 11 / 2011, the Tabajaras returned to their traditional territory, with an agrarian reform settlement. Some lots had been sold to the concrete company. On the 30th, a police operation for the unemployment of the area surprised the Indians, attempts at dialogue with the government and Funai were in vain. Two hundred police officers from the crash police, cavalry, cannil, elite battalion, helicopters and nearly a hundred private guards from the company clear up the Indians.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): En 9/11/2011, los Tabajaras retomaron parte de su territorio tradicional, en el que existía un asentamiento de reforma agraria. Algunos lotes se habían vendido a la empresa de cemento. El día 30, una operación policial para la desocupación del área sorprendió a los indios, intentos de diálogo con el gobierno y Funai fueron en vano. 200 policías de la tropa de choque, caballería, canil, batallón de élite, helicópteros y casi un centenar de guardias privados de la empresa, despejaron a los indios.

properties.event_description: The camp of about 400 Guaraní Kaiowá inside indigenous territory was attacked by pistoleros. According to the indigenous peoples, the attack lasted at least 4 hours and during this period, men, children and women were protected in the native jungle. They report that two rivers have separated the group from the gunmen, who have been performing at about 8 p.m. An indigenous man did not manage to flee and at that time disappeared. The attacks continued in the following weeks.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Pistoleros atacaron el campamento compuesto por cerca de 400 Guaraní Kaiowá dentro del territorio indígena. Según los indígenas, el ataque duró al menos 4 horas y, en este período, hombres, niños y mujeres se protegieron en la selva nativa. Ellos relatan que dos arroyos separaron al grupo de los pistoleros, que comenzaron a actuar alrededor de las 8 horas. Un indígena no logró huir y en aquel momento desapareció. Los ataques continuaron en las semanas siguientes.
properties.violence_context: Following the attack, in September, the video broadcast by the site Midiamax registered a farmer claiming that he was calling people to "war" against Indians in the region where the land was re-established. In his words, "these Indians there what isn't more, we'll give the pigs to eat." Delegate Marcelo Alexandre reported that PF would be monitoring the situation in the conflict region.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Después del ataque, en septiembre, el vídeo difundido por el sitio Midiamax registró un granjero declarando que estaba convocando a personas a la "guerra" contra los indios en la región donde se reanudó la tierra. En sus palabras: "Estos indios ahí lo que no sobra, vamos a dar a los cerdos a comer". El delegado Marcelo Alexandre informó que la PF estaría monitoreando la situación en la región del conflicto.

properties.event_description: Severino was hit by shots during Operation eldorado of the Federal police. Después de la invasión y destrucción de equipos de la aldea Teles Pires, fue uno de los 14 indígenas que policías federales arrestaron y llevaron a la sede de la Policía Federal en el municipio de SINOP, donde ellos dieron testimonio sin asistencia jurídica.
properties.violence_context: Some 400 federal police officers, National Forces, Funai and IBAMA entered into conflict with indigenous people as a result of an illegal gold-mining raft. There was confrontation and three indigenous people were killed. Two were wounded and Adenilson Krixi was killed by three shots fired by the PF delegate responsible for the operation. During the action, some indigenous people on their way to the agricultural area were intersected by helicopter with fire bursts.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Cerca de 400 policías federales, Fuerza Nacional, Funai e IBAMA entraron en conflicto con indígenas con ocasión de la detención de una balsa que hacía extracción ilegal de oro. Durante la acción, algunos indígenas en camino de la zona agrícola fueron interceptados por helicóptero con ráfagas de tiros.

properties.event_description: He returned to the village as he saw two cars blocking the road that gave access to the area and, perceiving the movement of the occupants of the vehicles, fled. The indigenous people report that they get threats from farmers constantly. The death threats became public at a meeting held between Funai and community farmers, at which one of the owners of the estate said that he himself would notice "some heads." He has reported but there have been no court decisions.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Retornaba a la aldea cuando percibió 2 coches bloqueando la carretera que da acceso al área y, percibiendo el movimiento de los ocupantes de los vehículos, huyó. El indígena relata que recibe amenazas de granjeros constantemente. Las amenazas de muerte se hicieron públicas en una reunión celebrada entre Funai y granjeros de la comunidad, en la que uno de los propietarios de la hacienda dijo que él mismo daría cuenta de "algunas cabezas". Ya denunció pero no ha habido decisiones judiciales.
properties.violence_context: The greed of the hooligans about the lands of the Xakriabas has been a cause of violence for decades. In 1987, three leaders were brutally killed in a massacre ordered by local officials, entrepreneurs and politicians, including the mayor of Itacarambi municipality. The case had a high national and international impact. Those involved were convicted and crime characterized as genocide. After 24 years, the xakriabá are undergoing a new fight to get back another part of their territory.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): La codicia de los acaparadores sobre las tierras de los Xakriabás es motivo de violencia desde hace décadas. En 1987, tres líderes fueron brutalmente asesinados en una masacre comandada por hacendados, empresarios y políticos, entre ellos el alcalde del municipio de Itacarambi. El caso tuvo gran repercusión nacional e internacional. Los involucrados fueron condenados, y el crimen caracterizado como genocidio. Pasados ​​24 años, los xakriabá están en un nuevo proceso de lucha para recuperar otra parte de su territorio.

properties.event_description: During monitoring of indigenous territory, the Guardianes del Bosque group found hunters from the town of Arame and seized their weapons and motorcycles. Due to the seizure, the hunters threatened to attack the village of Zitiwa. Fearing the attack, several indigenous people, including women and children, came to sleep in the forest for a few days.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Durante la vigilancia del territorio indígena, el grupo Guardianes del Bosque encontró cazadores del municipio de Arame y les incautaron sus armas y motos. A causa de la incautación, los cazadores amenazaron con atacar a la aldea Zutiwa. Temiendo el ataque, varios indígenas, entre ellos mujeres y niños, llegaron a dormir en el bosque por unos días.
properties.violence_context: The 10,000 indigenous people of Araribóia have been suffering with the illegal extraction of wood, threats and violence practised by the logging industry. Faced with the State's inability to secure preservation, they established an area protection group in 2008 - officialized as Forest Guardians in 2013. The performance had been an inconvenience to economic groups that moved the local economy with steels and carbons that had been illegally extracted and had resulted in growing retaliations.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Hace años, los 10 mil indígenas de Araribóia sufren con la extracción ilegal de madera, amenazas y violencia practicada por los madereros. Frente a la incapacidad del Estado en garantizar la preservación, en 2008 ellos crearon un grupo de protección del territorio - oficializado como Guardianes del Bosque en 2013. La actuación incomodó a grupos económicos que movían la economía local con aserraderos y carbones alimentados por madera extraída ilegalmente y generó represalias cada vez mayores.

properties.event_description: In a speech at the National Congress, Congressman Luis Carlos Heinze made statements that were discriminatory and contrary to constitutional determinations, in the case of demarcations of indigenous territories. He stated that his work was to "clear up the farce of the indigenous issue." He stated that the indigenous issue "was impeding the country" and made clear that his role as a representative of the Legislature did not seek to protect indigenous rights as determined by the Magnma Charter.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: En un discurso en el Congreso Nacional, el diputado Luis Carlos Heinze hizo declaraciones discriminatorias y contrarias a las determinaciones constitucionales, en el caso de las demarcaciones de territorios indígenas. Afirmó estar trabajando para "desmontar la farsa de la cuestión indígena". Dijo que la cuestión indígena "está obstaculizando el país" y dejó claro que en su actuación como representante del Poder Legislativo no busca proteger los derechos indígenas, como determinan la Carta Magna.
properties.violence_context: The indigenous organisations of the Northeast, Espítito Santo and Minas Gerais say that his speech breaks parliamentary decorum and accentuates his motif in a region where conflict about lands goes through permanent tension. The cases of the TI Tupinambá de Olivenza and the Paaxó lands with demarcation processes that have been unfinished by the federal government are the cause of the increased violence against indigenous people.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Las organizaciones indígenas del Nordeste, Espírito Santo y Minas Gerais afirman que el discurso del diputado rompe el decoro parlamentario y acentúa los ánimos en una región donde el conflicto por tierras pasa por tensión permanente. Los casos de la TI Tupinambá de Olivenza y de las tierras Pataxó aún con procesos de demarcación inconclusos por el gobierno federal son la causa de la mayor violencia contra los indígenas.

properties.event_description: A group of armed men, hired by farmers from the region, reached the area by truck and fired at the cacique. The victim's body was taken by the aggressors to an unknown place and was never found. The MPF (Federal Public Prosecutor's Office) accused 19 people of his murder and arrested the accused but later released them to have them responded. The criminal proceedings are still under way at the Federal Justice level.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Un grupo de hombres armados, contratados por granjeros de la región, llegaron al área en camioneta y efectuaron disparos contra el cacique. El cuerpo de la víctima fue llevado por los agresores a un lugar desconocido y nunca fue encontrado. El MPF (Ministerio Público Federal) denunció a 19 personas por el asesinato, arrestaron a los acusados pero luego los soltó para que respondieran en libertad. La acción penal aún está en tramite en la Justicia Federal.
properties.violence_context: The disputed area forms part of a TAC (term of conduct) signed in Brasilia by the Public Prosecutor's Office, Funai and indigenous leaders from the region, in November 2007. The TAC anticipates the resumption of the Tekoha, the traditional area that originated from about 39 indigenous communities, and been deported from the ground by tipsters that occupy the area.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El área en disputa forma parte de un TAC (Término de Ajuste de Conducta) firmado en Brasilia, por el Ministerio Público, Funai y líderes indígenas de la región, en noviembre de 2007. El TAC prevé la reanudación de los Tekoha, el área tradicional originaria de cerca de 39 comunidades indígenas, expulsadas de la tierra por hacendados que ocupan el área.

properties.event_description: The officials of the regional co-ordination of Funai in Empress initiated a campaign against the co-ordinator of COAPIMA (Coordination of the Organizations and Association of the Indigenous Peoples of Maranhão) creating a climate of threat. The indigenous have also been subjected to a number of threats from timber growers who wish to continue their illicit activities within indigenous lands.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Los funcionarios de la coordinación regional de la Funai en Emperatriz iniciaron una campaña contra el coordinador de la COAPIMA (Coordinación de las Organizaciones y Articulación de los Pueblos Indígenas de Maranhão) creando un clima de amenaza. El indígena también ha recibido varias amenazas de los madereros que desean continuar realizando sus actividades ilícitas dentro de la tierra indígena.
properties.violence_context: The 10,000 indigenous people of Araribóia have been suffering with the illegal extraction of wood, threats and violence practised by the logging industry. Faced with the State's inability to secure preservation, they established an area protection group in 2008 - officialized as Forest Guardians in 2013. The performance had been an inconvenience to economic groups that moved the local economy with steels and carbons that had been illegally extracted and had resulted in growing retaliations.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Hace años, los 10 mil indígenas de Araribóia sufren con la extracción ilegal de madera, amenazas y violencia practicada por los madereros. Frente a la incapacidad del Estado en garantizar la preservación, en 2008 ellos crearon un grupo de protección del territorio - oficializado como Guardianes del Bosque en 2013. La actuación incomodó a grupos económicos que movían la economía local con aserraderos y carbones alimentados por madera extraída ilegalmente y generó represalias cada vez mayores.

properties.event_description: The indigenous people, together with teachers and students, mobilized against the reforms put forward by the federal government at BR-285. Following his mobilization, Uirappurum.Paso Fundo radio made a photo record and posted his Facebook page. The report became important and a number of prethought comments were published, as: "Fan's troops will work,"... "To fill his face with cachaça is culture?" and so forth. The complaint was submitted to the Public Prosecutor's Office at Passo Fundo.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Los indígenas, junto con profesores y alumnos, realizaron una movilización contra las reformas propuestas por el gobierno federal, en la BR-285. Ante la movilización, la Radio Uirapuru-Paso Fundo hizo un registro fotográfico y publicó en su página de Facebook. El reportaje tomó importancia y una serie de comentarios preconcebidos fueron publicados, como: "tropa de vagabundos van a trabajar", "... llenar la cara de cachaça es cultura?" etcétera. La denuncia fue entregada al Ministerio Público en Passo Fundo.

properties.event_description: Several local authorities, together with illegal miners deported from Munduruku land earlier this year, organized a demonstration that resulted in hostility and moral and physical violence as well as reddish shots that seriously wounded the indigenous Rosalvo Kaba and Francette Koru.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Varias autoridades del municipio, junto a mineros ilegales expulsados de la tierra Munduruku a principios de año, organizaron una manifestación que tuvo como resultado la hostilidad, la violencia moral y física, además de tiros de rojón que dejaron gravemente heridos a los indígenas Rosalvo Kaba y Francinete Koru.
properties.violence_context: In January 2014, the Munduruku conducted an operation to withdraw illegal mining from their lands. In February, the town of Jacareacanga had been dissatisfied with the role of the indigenous people with regard to hydropower stations at the Tapajós and with the deportation of the miners and had fired 70 indigenous teachers. The Munduruku protested. On the day before the demonstration of the 13th, a teacher support house was burned and the fact was attributed to the indigenous people. They deny the prosecution.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): En enero de 2014, los Munduruku realizaron operación de retirada de la minería ilegal de sus tierras. En febrero, insatisfechos con el rol de los indígenas contra las hidroeléctricas en el Tapajós y con la expulsión de los mineros, el Ayuntamiento de Jacareacanga despidió a 70 profesores indígenas. Los Munduruku protestaron. En el día anterior a la manifestación del día 13, una casa de apoyo a los profesores fue incendiada y el hecho fue atribuido a los indígenas. Ellos niegan la acusación.

properties.event_description: Following the invasion and destruction of equipment from the village of Teles Pires, at the so-called Operation Eldorado, the Federal police arrested 14 indigenous people and brought them to the headquarters of the Federal police in the municipality of SINOP (Mato Grosso), where indigenous people gave testimony without legal assistance.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Después de la invasión y destrucción de equipos de la aldea Teles Pires, en la llamada Operación Eldorado, la Policía Federal arrestó a 14 indígenas llevándolos a la sede de la Policía Federal en el municipio de SINOP (Mato Grosso), donde los indígenas dieron testimonios sin asistencia jurídica.
properties.violence_context: Some 400 federal police officers, National Forces, Funai and IBAMA entered into conflict with indigenous people as a result of an illegal gold-mining raft. There was confrontation and three indigenous people were killed. Two were wounded and Adenilson Krixi was killed by three shots fired by the PF delegate responsible for the operation. During the action, some indigenous people on their way to the agricultural area were intersected by helicopter with fire bursts.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Cerca de 400 policías federales, Fuerza Nacional, Funai e IBAMA entraron en conflicto con indígenas con ocasión de la detención de una balsa que hacía extracción ilegal de oro. Hubo enfrentamiento y a tres indígenas les dispararon. Dos fueron heridos y Adenilson Krixi murió por tres tiros disparados por el delegado de la PF responsable de la operación. Durante la acción, algunos indígenas en camino de la zona agrícola fueron interceptados por helicóptero con ráfagas de tiros.

properties.event_description: Ozimar reported being threatened by one of the miners deported from indigenous territory. He was approached by a man, who came up and shown a machete asking if he was under his supervision that tipped out the miners. Ozimar refused. The man said I'd stab the first person that he knew was involved with that monitoring business.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Ozimar relató haber sido amenazado por uno de los mineros expulsados del territorio indígena. Fue abordado por un hombre, que se acercó y mostró un machete preguntando si estaba en la fiscalización que expulsó a los mineros. Ozimar se negó. El hombre dijo que apuñalaría al primero que él supiera que estaba involucrado en ese negocio de fiscalización.
properties.violence_context: There are serious conflicts in the region as a result of the Munduruku's fight against dams in the Tapajós and the constant invasions of miners on their lands that cause river pollution, fish and violent conflict. Despite the denunciations, the government did not act to withdraw the invaders. Tired to wait, in January 2014, the indigenous people expelled tens of miners and grabbed dragons illegally used to extract gold.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Hay serios conflictos en la región en función de la lucha de los Munduruku contra las represas en el Tapajós y las constantes invasiones de mineros en sus tierras que causan la contaminación de ríos, mortandad de peces y conflictos violentos. A pesar de las denuncias, el gobierno no actúa para retirar a los invasores. Cansados de esperar, en enero de 2014 los indígenas expulsaron decenas de mineros y agarraron dragas utilizadas ilegalmente para extraer oro.

He thinks that after all there's a farmer's lawyer.

El padre dijo que no fueron respetados porque se señaló que el menor era el culpable del sacrificio. Además, no querían dar el nombre del denunciante. Él cree que detrás de todo está un abogado granjero.

properties.event_description: The indigenous man was an historic leader of the Xukurul-Kariri people and was killed as he prepared to go to his attic. Two unidentified individuals called the leader that as they leave the house to see who she was, she was stabbed and fired with a gun. The previous day, she had been at his people's II Pedagogical Seminary, with a memory of his leading maninha Xukuru, killed 10 years ago.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: El indígena era un líder histórico del pueblo Xukuru-Kariri y fue asesinado cuando se preparaba para ir al rozado que mantenía. Dos individuos no identificados llamaron al lider que, al salir de la casa para ver quién era, recibió puñaladas y disparos de arma de fuego. El día anterior, había participado en el II Seminario Pedagógico de su pueblo, que recordaba la lideresa Maninha Xukuru, muerta hace 10 años.
properties.violence_context: The region has a history of violence from fighting for land. The village Fazenda Canto consists of the 72 hectares demarcated in 1952, where Seu Jão lived, as a result of the resumption of the last few years and some of the demarcation put into place by Funai but paralyzed in 2013. In 2013, after an uprising was suspended, Cimi reported interference by Alagoas politicians, who had called for a suspension of demarcation work.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): La región tiene un historial de violencia de la lucha por la tierra. La aldea Fazenda Canto está compuesta por las 72 hectáreas demarcadas en 1952, donde Seu João vivía, por la reanudación de los últimos años y parte de la demarcación puesta en marcha por la Funai pero paralizada en 2013. En 2013, cuando el levantamiento de tierras fue suspendido, el Cimi denunció la interferencia de políticos de Alagoas, que habían pedido la suspensión de los trabajos de demarcación.

properties.event_description: After regaining some of their territory, indigenous people have been subjected to threats with insults and shooting at the community. The Public Security Secretariat found that the car run by the aggressors belonged to a security company called Ostensive Private Security.

properties.violence_context: The Gamela are constantly intimidated, threatened and discriminated against. A few weeks after the Gamela village attack, drones overflew several village villages. properties.event_description: A judge questioned the Gamela's ethnic identity, claiming that they were no longer "sylvilogical," but integrated with national society. The preliminary decision of the court gave 30 days to clear up the families of the local known as Sitio Chulanga. The CPT's lawyer, Rafael Silva, stated that State Justice was incompetent to give such a decision, which was up to the Federal Justice. He stated that the decision attests to a preconceived posture of indigenous people.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Un juez cuestionó la identidad étnica de los Gamela, alegando no ser más "silvícolas", sino integrados a la sociedad nacional. La decisión preliminar de la justicia concedió 30 días para el cumplimiento del despeje de las familias indígenas del local conocido como Sitio Chulanga. El abogado de la CPT, Rafael Silva, afirmó que la Justicia Estatal es incompetente para conceder tal decisión, que corresponde a la Justicia Federal. Afirmó que la decisión demuestra una postura preconcebida de los indígenas.

El juez entendió que la prisión fue realizada de forma ilegal, sin elementos para ello.

properties.violence_context: Since 2004, the Tupinambá de Olivença have been regaining their ancestral territory. The indigenous mobilization unleashed an acute process of repression and criminalization. In January 2014, 3 bases were established in indigenous lands, with the start of the permanent military occupation of the Territory, which would extend for more than a year. Indigenous people from different IT regions have been arrested or accused and also threatened and attacked by non-indigenous anti-demarcation. Source: Ponte.org
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Desde 2004, los Tupinambá de Olivença vienen retomando su territorio ancestral. Indígenas de diferentes regiones de la TI han sido arrestados o acusados, y también amenazados y atacados por no indígenas contrarios a la demarcación. Fuente: Ponte.org

properties.defence_activity: Its ancestral territory from logging by invading logging and from expanding the agricultural border and mobile charcoal.
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su territorio ancestral de la tala de bosque por madereros invasores, de la expansión de la frontera agrícola y carboneras móbiles.
properties.event_description: The body was found at the Mearim River with signs of strangulation. The daughter stated that his father had been suffering from threats as a result of his dispute about his possession of his land. The case was reported to the Civil Police but insufficient attention was paid. Civil police closed a few-day investigation leading to drowning - even with signs of choking and other violence. The Federal Public Prosecutor's Office (MPF) of Empress received a report that the indigenous person had been receiving indirect threats from Ednewton Fontenele Viana, and have been given up by Francisco Pereira dos Santos.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: El cuerpo fue encontrado en el río Mearim, con señales de estrangulamiento. La hija declaró que el padre venía sufriendo amenazas debido a la disputa por la posesión de la tierra. El caso fue denunciado a la Policía Civil, pero no se dio la debida atención. La policía civil cerró una investigación de pocos días concluyendo ahogamiento - incluso con signos de estrangulamiento y demás violencias. El Ministerio Público Federal (MPF) de Emperatriz recibió denuncia de que el indígena venía recibiendo amenazas indirectas de Ednewton Fontenele Viana, entregadas siempre por Francisco Pereira dos Santos.
properties.violence_context: José Dias is one of the six Guajajara to whom they brought their lives in the 90-day period at the end of 2016. The Guajajara of the I Bacirizinho have been fighting for more than 3 decades for the whole of indigenous territory. Since 2011, Funai has been unable to put up with the physical frameworks of the earth: and other non-indigenous occupants have been unable to do so. The activities of these occupants include mobile chartering, cattle and damaged areas for the sale of noble wood.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): José Dias es uno de los seis Guajajara a quien sacaron la vida en el período de 90 días a finales de 2016. Los Guajajara de la TI Bacurizinho luchan desde hace más de 3 décadas por la totalidad del territorio indígena. Desde 2011, la Funai no logra realizar la colocación de los marcos físicos de la tierra: hacendados y demás ocupantes no indígenas no lo permiten. Entre las actividades de esos ocupantes están carbonerias móviles, ganaderías y áreas devastadas para la venta de madera noble.

Por las denuncias, sufren amenazas de muerte de los narcotraficantes y de los madereros que pasan en su territorio, generalmente por la noche. En varias ocasiones les apuntan con armas de fuego a las comunidades.

properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Defienden el territorio indígena de la invasión de madereros, granjeros, mineros, cazadores y pescadores ilegales
properties.event_description: The anti-indigenous farmers are promoting actions against the Bororo community. According to leaders, police conduct rounds near the village and shoot with the aim of intimidating indigenous people.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Los agricultores contrarios a los derechos de los indígenas promueven acciones contra la comunidad Bororo. Según los líderes, policías hacen rondas cerca de la aldea y efectúan disparos con el objetivo de intimidar a los indígenas.
properties.violence_context: Projected since 1950, traditional territory remains invaded by a small non-indigenous community. The invaders illegally extracted wood, extracted gold and burned pashlands as well as fishing and hunting. Another problem faced by indigenous peoples was the use of agrotoxic products at the headquarters of rivers passing through indigenous territory.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Demarcada desde 1950, el territorio tradicional sigue invadido por una pequeña comunidad de no indígenas. Los invasores extraen ilegalmente madera, extraen oro e incendian pastizales, además de practicar la pesca y la caza ilegal. Otro problema que enfrentan los indígenas es el uso de agrotóxicos en las cabeceras de los ríos que pasan por el territorio indígena.

properties.violence_context: The 10,000 indigenous people of Araribóia have been suffering with the illegal extraction of wood, threats and violence practised by the logging industry. Faced with the State's inability to secure preservation, they established an area protection group in 2008 - officialized as Forest Guardians in 2013. The performance had been an inconvenience to economic groups that moved the local economy with steels and carbons that had been illegally extracted and had resulted in growing retaliations.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Hace años, los 10 mil indígenas de Araribóia sufren con la extracción ilegal de madera, amenazas y violencia practicada por los madereros. Frente a la incapacidad del Estado en garantizar la preservación, en 2008 ellos crearon un grupo de protección del territorio - oficializado como Guardianes del Bosque en 2013. La actuación incomodó a grupos económicos que movían la economía local con aserraderos y carbones alimentados por madera extraída ilegalmente y generó represalias cada vez mayores.

properties.defence_activity: Its territory of construction of 2 hydroelectric complexes, Tapajós and Teles Pires, part of the Program of Acceleration of Federal Growth. They face illegal deforestation for cattle, land grabbing and illegal mining.
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su territorio de la construcción de 2 Complejos Hidroeléctricos, Tapajós y Teles Pires, parte del Programa de Aceleración del Crecimiento federal. Enfrentan tb deforestación ilegal para ganado,acaparamiento de tierras y minería ilegal.
properties.event_description: At the hearing at the House of Councillors, the community reported that while at the stage some indigenous people were on their way to the Roza, they were intersected by helicopter with fire bursts. The police were dividing them into groups and the men were assaulted. Women and children were put under a scorching sun and under police surveillance.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: En la audiencia en la Cámara de los concejales, la comunidad denunció que durante la diligencia, algunos indígenas que se encontraban en el camino de la roza, fueron interceptados por helicóptero con ráfagas de tiros. Los policías los dividían en grupos y los hombres eran agredidos. Las mujeres y los niños fueron puestos bajo un sol abrasador y bajo vigilancia de los policías.
properties.violence_context: Some 400 federal police officers, National Forces, Funai and IBAMA entered into conflict with indigenous people while arresting an illegal gold-mining raft at Operation Eldorado. Indigenous people were wounded and Adenilson Krixi died with 3 shots to his leg and 1 to his head fired by the PF delegate responsible for the operation. Since the beginning of the year, after the Justice have paralyzed the works of the Teles Pires I hydropower, the indigenous people have been under threat.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Cerca de 400 policías federales, Fuerza Nacional, Funai e IBAMA entraron en conflicto con indígenas durante la detención de una balsa de extracción ilegal de oro, en la llamada Operación Eldorado. Indígenas fueron heridos y Adenilson Krixi murió con 3 tiros en la pierna y 1 en la cabeza disparados por el delegado de la PF responsable de la operación. Desde el comienzo del año, después que la Justicia paralizó las obras de la hidroeléctrica Teles Pires I, los indígenas venían sufriendo amenazas.

properties.event_description: A Guarani indigenous woman passed out during an eviction action unleashed by pits, and burned barracks and documents and some indigenous possessions. Some indigenous people have been trying to help her but the farmers have been forced to leave them. Another Guaraní who tried to help her was pushed with an outsider. The farmers did not let anyone help the indigenous woman, who remained faint for three hours under the sun. The deportation of indigenous people was published on Facebook by the National Property Guarantee Organization (Ordup).
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Durante una acción de desalojo desencadenada por hacendados, que quemaron barracas, documentos y algunas posesiones de los indígenas, una indígena guaraní desmayó. Algunos indígenas intentaron ayudarla, pero los granjeros no los dejaron. Otra guaraní que intentó socorrerla fue empujada con un porrete fuera del lugar. Los granjeros no dejaron que nadie ayudara a la indígena, que permaneció desmayada durante tres horas bajo el sol. La expulsión de los indígenas fue publicada en el Facebook de la Organización Nacional de Garantía de Propiedad (Orgdip).

properties.defence_activity: Her ancestral territory against the mineral exploration of Silvinite by mining companies Potassio do Brasil. The community requires consultation about the mega-project that would have an impact on traditional lands.
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su territorio ancestral contra la exploración mineral de silvinita por la empresas mineras Potássio do Brasil. La comunidad exige ser consultada sobre el megaproyecto que incidiria sobre las tierras tradicionales.
properties.event_description: Proclaiming his efforts, the town hall included accusations against the town, claiming that the indigenous people did not care about the development of the town, because they did not accept the exploitation of wild minerals on their lands, leading to the population against the indigenous people. The Mura demand to be consulted about mega-entrepreneurship that affects traditional lands and, accordingly, their way of life. The authorities later went to the villages claiming that the indigenous people had been consulted and consented to mining. That happened after the Justice sealed an agreement with the company Potasio of Brazil requiring that the work be stopped until the consultation process with the indigenous and traditional peoples affected.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Al hacer propaganda de sus gestiones, la alcaldía del municipio incluyó acusaciones contra el pueblo, alegando que los indígenas no querían el desarrollo del municipio, porque no aceptaban la explotación de minerales silvestres en sus tierras, llevando a la población contra los indígenas. Los Mura exigen ser consultados sobre el mega emprendimiento que incide sobre las tierras tradicionales y, consecuentemente, su modo de vida. Posteriormente, las autoridades fueron hasta las aldeas alegando que los indígenas habían sido consultados y habían consentido con la explotación minera. Este hecho ocurrió cuando la Justicia selló un acuerdo con la empresa Potasio de Brasil exigiendo la paralización de la obra hasta que el proceso de consulta fuera realizado con los indígenas y las poblaciones tradicionales afectadas.

properties.event_description: Several people from the indigenous community were threatened with death for false charges of burglary by an invader of the ground, nicknamed Tonão. There are indications that she has hired two gunmen to kill indigenous people. The Munduruku caciques and other leaders have been denouncing the threats they have been suffering to the MPF. The community called for the eviction of invaders from indigenous lands.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Varias personas de la comunidad indígena fueron amenazadas de muerte por falsa acusación de robo hecha por un invasor de la tierra, de apodo Tonão. Hay indicios de que ha contratado dos pistoleros para matar a indígenas. Los caciques Munduruku y otros líderes denunciaron las amenazas que vienen sufriendo al MPF. La comunidad solicita el desalojo de los invasores de la tierra indígena.
properties.violence_context: Tonhão claims to own a farm that's outsourced to indigenous territory, where it illegally production and commercializes the paddle. There are reports of neighbours close to the indigenous area that accused Tonão of his murder of his first wife and that's why his name was used to pass unnoticed.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Tonhão dice ser dueño de una granja que está superpuesta al territorio indígena, donde produce y comercializa ilegalmente el palmito. Hay informes de vecinos cercanos al área indígena que acusan a Tonão de haber asesinado a la primera esposa, por ello el uso de un apodo para pasar desapercibido.

properties.defence_activity: Her ancestral territory of logging by invaders.
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su territorio ancestral de la tala de bosque por madereros invasores.
properties.event_description: The indigenous people report threats of timber, fear an invasion and a new conflict. According to Leader Marcelo Gavião, the entrance of invaders to exploit wood into indigenous territory has been common and the indigenous people themselves have been keeping their forest guard. Nevertheless, after the indigenous people had been trying to block the entrance of the trucks, they had been threatening to invade one of the villages.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Los indígenas reportan amenazas de madereros, temen una invasión en la aldea y un nuevo conflicto. Según el lider Marcelo Gavião, la entrada de invasores para explotar madera en el territorio indígena ha sido frecuente y los propios indígenas hacen la guardia forestal. Sin embargo, después de que los indígenas intentaron bloquear la entrada de los camiones, los madereros amenazaron con invadir una de las aldeas.
properties.violence_context: The indigenous territory of the Governor at Amarante do Maranhão is where Gavião and Tenetehara have been living. Although regularized by the Funai, free movement of timber is not prevented. There are at least 4 points of wood extraction. In March 2017, the indigenous José Gavião and Sonia Gavião were hit and killed by a timber truck. In a year, that was the third death from assault. The cacique Evandro Luís says that indigenous people consider a retaliation. Source: EBC
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El territorio indígena del Governador em Amarante do Maranhão es donde viven las etnias Gavião y Tenetehara. A pesar de ser regularizada por la Funai, no se impide la libre circulación de madereros. Hay al menos 4 puntos de extracción de madera. En marzo/2017, los indígenas José Gavião y Sonia Gavião fueron atropellados y muertos por un camión de madereros. En un año, fue la tercera muerte por atropellamiento. El cacique Evandro Luís dice que los indígenas consideran una represalia. Fuente: EBC

properties.event_description: Indigenous people living in a manaus neighborhood have been subjected to extortion and death threats by a type of militia for months. The residents of the settlement are required to pay light and water charges that are not legalized by companies. Their lands are confiscated and sold. They refuse to surrender the lots, their houses are predator and burned and the inhabitants are assaulted or face death threats. They say at least two deaths have already happened at the Park.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Indígenas que viven en un barrio de Manaos han sido víctimas, desde hace meses, de extorsión y amenazas de muerte por parte de un tipo de milicia. Los residentes del asentamiento están obligados a pagar tasas de luz y agua que no son legalizadas por las empresas. Sus terrenos son confiscados y vendidos. Se niegan a entregar los lotes, sus casas son depredadas y quemadas y los moradores son agredidos o sufren amenazas de muerte. Afirman que al menos dos muertes ya ocurrieron en el Parque.
properties.violence_context: According to a witness, in August, indigenous people sought out the Federal Public Prosecutor's Office and reported abuses but were retaliated weeks later.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Según un testigo, en agosto, los indígenas buscaron al Ministerio Público Federal y denunciaron los abusos pero semanas después sufrieron represalias.

properties.defence_activity: His ancestral territory from the illegal logging of forests by invaders.
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su territorio ancestral de la tala ilegal de bosque por madereros invasores.
properties.event_description: On the 28th, after farmers and timber companies threatened to set fire to the village's houses, they set fire to Floriano's house, first within the boundaries of the indigenous land. Due to the threats, the indigenous people had come out of the house and thus avoid a bigger tragedy. Cimi and leaders filed a complaint with the South River MPF and with the 6th MPF House in Brasilia, which was directed by the Federal police to protect and calm the situation.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: El día 28, después de que agricultores y madereros amenazaran con incendiar las casas de la aldea, prendieron fuego en la casa del indígena Floriano, la primera dentro de los límites de la tierra indígena. Debido a las amenazas, los indígenas habían salido de la casa, evitando así una tragedia mayor. Cimi y líderes ofrecieron denuncia al MPF de Río del Sur y a la 6ª Cámara del MPF en Brasilia, que destinó la Policía Federal para proteger y apaciguar la situación.
properties.violence_context: Indigenous people from the community had been to the wood station near the village to check if the owner was withdrawing wood from the reforestation project from indigenous territory. Following their approach they were fired at by officials. The indigenous people then closed the road that cuts down the indigenous territory and that connects the municipalities of José Boiteux and Vítor Meirels. In retaliation for the indigenous movement, farmers and logging threatened to set fire to community houses.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Indígenas de la comunidad habían ido hasta la maderera cerca de la aldea para verificar si el propietario estaba retirando madera del proyecto de reforestación del territorio indígena. Al acercarse fueron recibidos a tiros por los funcionarios. Los indígenas entonces cerraron la carretera que corta el territorio indígena y que conecta los municipios de José Boiteux y Vítor Meireles. En represalia al movimiento de los indígenas, los agricultores y los madereros amenazaron con incendiar las casas de la comunidad.

According to ChiquINho Karapotó cacique, the current reserve isn't sufficient to accommodate the local ethnic communities. "We have no place to plant," said the cacique.

Ellos ocupan la hacienda Salobra y alegan que la hacienda forma parte de un área tradicionalmente indígena. Según el cacique Chiquinho Karapotó, la actual reserva no es suficiente para acoger las etnias existentes en el municipio. "Estamos sin lugar para plantar", dijo el cacique.

properties.defence_activity: They fight the indigenous territory and wood forest, living in protective areas created to contain invasions
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Defienden el territorio indígena y el bosque de los madereros, vivendo en areas de protección creadas para contener las invasiones
properties.event_description: The families living in three protection areas established to prevent logging from entering indigenous lands were threatened. They were told they would have consequences if they stayed at these locations and prevented the trucks and machines from entering. The families left their protective areas and returned to their respective villages and the entrance was free for them to return. The Funai did not place monitoring and monitoring points at the boundaries of indigenous lands.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Las familias que vivían en tres áreas de protección creadas para impedir la entrada de madereros en la tierra indígena fueron amenazadas. Les dijeron que sufrirían consecuencias si permanecian en estos lugares impediendo la entrada de los camiones y las máquinas. Las familias abandonaron las áreas de protección, retornando a sus respectivas aldeas y la entrada quedó libre para que los agresores regresaran. La Funai no hizo la instalación de los puestos de vigilancia ni la fiscalización en los límites de la tierra indígena.
properties.violence_context: Due to the State's omission, the Ka'apor have put into place an autonomous plan of actions to uphold their territory since 2013. They established their own forest guard, who closed improvised roads, burned vehicles used for transport and tipped them out. They created protective areas to make it difficult to gain access to the indigenous territory. The protective actions have been occurring for more than a year and have been leading to growing retaliations.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Debido a la omisión del Estado, los Ka'apor pusieron en práctica un plan autónomo de acciones de defensa de su territorio desde 2013. Crearon su propia guardia del bosque, que cierra carreteras improvisadas, quema vehículos utilizados en el transporte y expulsa a los madereros del territorio. Crearon áreas de protección para dificultar el acceso al interior del territorio indígena. Las acciones de protección ocurren desde hace más de un año, y generan represalias cada vez mayores.

properties.event_description: A group of about 200 people have been serious attacks on the Gamela community. 22 indigenous people were wounded and 2 of them were killed and 2 had their hands cut off. Other Gamela suffered attacks with machetes and sticks. The interns will meet to organize or attack the area of Santero. The call was put forward by social networks and local radio programs, including with statements of support from the federal deputy Aluísio Guimarães Mendes Filho of the PTN / MA (currently we can).
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Un grupo de aproximadamente 200 personas atacaron severamente a la comunidad Gamela. 22 indígenas fueron heridos, 2 de ellos fueron baleados y 2 tuvieron sus manos cortadas. Otros Gamela sufrieron ataques con machetes y palos. Los reos se encontrarán para organizar o atacar el área de Santero. La convocatoria fue realizada por las redes sociales y en programas de radio locales, incluso con declaraciones de apoyo del diputado federal Aluísio Guimarães Mendes Filho, del PTN/MA (actual Podemos).
properties.violence_context: The Gamela re-invindicates an area in the north of Maranhão donated by the Portuguese crown in the 18th century, that would have been occupied by farmers and did throughout the years. Since 2015, with no state order for the demarcation of their lands, the group of about 1200 people have been regaining their ancestral territory. On 30 April, farmers gathered around the "Movement for Peace" group with the participation of politicians held a violent action against the Gamela.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Los Gamela reinvindicam un área en el norte de Maranhão donado por la corona portuguesa en el siglo XVIII, que habría sido ocupada por agricultores y hacendados a lo largo de los años. Desde el 2015, sin ninguna providencia del Estado para la demarcación de sus tierras, el grupo de cerca de 1200 personas retomó su territorio ancestral. El 30 de abril, granjeros reunidos en torno al grupo "Movimiento por la Paz", con la participación de políticos, realizaron una violenta acción contra los Gamela.

properties.event_description: The cacique was at a warehouse inside the village when she was surprised by criminals who arrived in a white car. The indigenous person was shot at by five shots in the region of his face and taken to his hospital but did not resist his attack. The cacique was suspected to have been killed as a result of an anti-leaking activity, a common practice in the region. His attitude would have been dissatisfied with people who historically exploit indigenous lands. The Federal police opened an investigation to investigate the crime.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: El cacique estaba en un almacén dentro de la aldea cuando fue sorprendido por criminales que llegaron en un vehículo de color blanco. Al indígena le dieron cinco tiros en la región del tóra, fue llevado al hospital, pero no resistió el ataque. Se sospecha que el cacique ha sido asesinado porque pasó a actuar contra el arrendamiento de tierras, práctica común en la región. Su actitud habría tenido descontentos a personas que históricamente explotan las tierras indígenas. La Policía Federal abrió una investigación para investigar el crimen.

properties.event_description: Farmers and traders, summoned by an office of the "Commission of Indigenous Invasion of the Municipality," invaded Kaingang camp destroyed barracks, threw their belongings onto trucks and pushed them into a van. Following their transport by about 140 km, they were deported from the headquarters of the Funai in the town of Passo Fundo.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Agricultores y comerciantes, convocados por un oficio de la "Comisión de la Invasión Indígena del municipio", invadieron el campamento Kaingang destruyeron barracas, arrojaron sus pertenencias sobre camiones y empujaron a los indígenas hacia dentro de una furgoneta. Después de ser transportados por cerca de 140 km, fueron expulsados frente a la sede de la Funai, en la ciudad de Passo Fundo.
properties.violence_context: The camp situated close to the area claimed by the indigenous as traditional, Erval Grande includes a region with the municipality of Vicente Dutra, where in November 2013, during the Public Court of the Commission of Agriculture, federal deputies Luiz Carlos Heinze (PP-RS) and Alcau Moreira (PMDBRS) called on settlers to resist "as it may be" against indigenous peoples claiming traditional territories.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El campamento situado cerca del área reivindicada por los indígenas como tradicional, Erval Grande compone una región que cuenta con el municipio de Vicente Dutra, lugar en que en el mes de noviembre de 2013, durante la Audiencia Pública de la Comisión de Agricultura, los diputados federales Luiz Carlos Heinze (PP-RS) y Alceu Moreira (PMDB-RS) convocaron a los colonos a resistir "de la forma que sea" contra los pueblos indígenas que reivindican territorios tradicionales.

properties.event_description: The community claims that it will be intimidated and prevented from passing through the place as a result of armed gunmen. They are without food, without water and without locomotion, living under threat of death. Information indicates that children are ill because of their conditions.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: La comunidad denuncia que estaría sufriendo intimidaciones y que está impedida en su libre transitar por el lugar debido a pistoleros armados. Ellos están sin comida, sin agua y sin locomoción, viviendo bajo amenaza de muerte. Hay información que cuenta que habría niños que están enfermos debido a las condiciones que enfrentan.
properties.violence_context: Funai officials did not come to the place to care for indigenous people because they were intimidated so as to avoid approaching the indigenous camp. The last time the indigenous people attempted to relocate their lands, in October 2009, they were violently attacked by armed men. On that occasion, the body of indigenous teacher Genivaldo Vera was found. Professor Rolindo Vera, who was there, remains missing and there are suspicions that he has been killed as well.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Funcionarios de la Funai no llegaron al lugar para prestar atención a los indígenas porque fueron intimidados para no acercarse al campamento indígena. La última vez que los indígenas intentaron reubicar sus tierras, en octubre de 2009, fueron violentamente atacados por hombres armados. En esa ocasión, el cuerpo del profesor indígena Genivaldo Vera fue encontrado. El profesor Rolindo Vera, que estaba allí, sigue desaparecido y hay sospechas de que también ha sido asesinado.

properties.event_description: The indigenous people were assaulted in different forms and threatened with death. Several entrance tickets to villages are blocked by people linked to logging. A group of indigenous people reported that the retreates from the area would be re-entering the Territory and that a Funai server (accompanying the Ibama's team in monitoring the land) would be negotiating the entry of timber into both indigenous territories.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Los indígenas fueron agredidos de diferentes formas y amenazados de muerte. Varias entradas de acceso a las aldeas son bloqueadas por personas ligadas a los madereros. Un grupo de indígenas denunció que los madereros retirados del área estarían nuevamente entrando en el territorio, y que un servidor de la Funai (que acompañaba al equipo del Ibama en la fiscalización de la tierra) estaría negociando la entrada de madereros en los dos territorios indígenas.
properties.violence_context: The server had been reported by indigenous people in 2013 for negotiating the illegal sale of wood in the municipality. The indigenous peoples would also be coerced by local authorities to facilitate logging (including by public officials for the recovery of local bridges) under the threat of cutting benefits, such as Bolsa Familia.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El servidor ya había sido denunciado en 2013 por los indígenas por negociar la venta ilegal de madera en el municipio. Los indígenas también estarían siendo coaccionados por autoridades locales para facilitar la explotación de la madera (incluso por funcionarios públicos para la recuperación de puentes del municipio) bajo la amenaza de corte de beneficios, como Bolsa Familia.

properties.event_description: At dawn, about 10 men attacked the living community at the BR-483 margins. They threatened the indigenous people by claiming that if they did not leave the place, they would have been killed. They would have said that whoever was in command of the occupied road area was not the Federal police but the "police of the company." The reason for the attack was the indigenous circulation to collect water in a private area. The aggressors burned mattresses, blankets, bikes, clothes and wounded indigenous people with shots and knives.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Durante la madrugada, unos 10 hombres atacaron a la comunidad que vive acampada a los márgenes de la BR-483. Amenazaron a los indígenas afirmando que, si ellos no abandonan el lugar, habrían muertes. Habrían dicho que quien mandaba en el área de la carretera ocupada no era la Policía Federal, sino la "policía de la empresa". La razón del ataque sería la circulación indígena para recoger agua en área privada. Los agresores quemaron colchones, mantas, bicicletas, ropas e hirieron a indígenas con tiros y cuchillos.
properties.violence_context: The community has been living at least six years at the margins of BR-483 while awaiting the demarcation of its traditional land. According to the MF-MS report, the status of the community is "similar to that of a refugee camp. It's as if they're foreigners in their own countries." The attack occurred 4 days after the fire that burned houses and some objects from another Guarani community, the Laranjeira Ñanderu, camped by the BR-163.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): La comunidad vive desde hace al menos seis años a los márgenes de la BR-483, mientras espera la demarcación de su tierra tradicional. Según el informe del MPF-MS, la situación de la comunidad es "análoga a la de un campo de refugiados. Es como si fueran extranjeros en su propio país." El ataque ocurrió 4 días después del incendio que quemó casas y algunos objetos de otra comunidad Guarani, la Laranjeira Ñanderu, acampada al borde de la BR-163.

properties.event_description: The community suffered a serious attack, leading to Clodiodi's death. A further 6 indigenous people were wounded, including a 12-year-old child. In recordings made by the indigenous people themselves, more than a hundred men with arms can be seen, with motorcycles burned and few indigenous belongings.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: La comunidad sufrió un grave ataque, que resultó en la muerte de Clodiodi. Otros seis indígenas fueron heridos, incluso un niño de 12 años. En grabaciones hechas por los propios indígenas, es posible ver más de un centenar de hombres armados, quemando motos y las pocas pertenencias de los indígenas.
properties.violence_context: Those attacks occurred after a group of local leaders and politicians promised to cancel the recognition of the newly published territory of Dourados Amamambaipegua I. Fearing to lose their rights to ancestral land, indigenous families regained a small area of the perimeter as a traditional territory and suffered a disproportionate response from the armed groups.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Estos ataques ocurrieron después de que un grupo de hacendados y políticos locales prometieron la anulación del reconocimiento del territorio recién publicado de Dourados Amambaipegua I. Con miedo de perder sus derechos a la tierra ancestral, familias indígenas retomaron una pequeña área del perímetro identificado como territorio tradicional y sufrieron una reacción desproporcionada por parte de los grupos armados.

properties.event_description: The indigenous man was killed with sticks inside his own village. To the leaders, this is another logging assault against indigenous people in retaliation for the monitoring that these peoples are currently undertaking to inhibit the invasion of logging in their traditional territory.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: El indigena fue muerto a palos dentro de la propia aldea. Para los líderes, se trata de otra agresión de madereros contra los indígenas en represalia a la fiscalización que estos pueblos están realizando para inhibir la invasión de madereros en su territorio tradicional.
properties.violence_context: The 10,000 indigenous people of Araribóia have been suffering with the illegal extraction of wood, threats and violence practised by the logging industry. Faced with the State's inability to secure preservation, they established an area protection group in 2008 - officialized as Forest Guardians in 2013. The performance had been an inconvenience to economic groups that moved the local economy with steels and carbons that had been illegally extracted and had resulted in growing retaliations.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Hace años, los 10 mil indígenas de Araribóia sufren con la extracción ilegal de madera, amenazas y violencia practicada por los madereros. Frente a la incapacidad del Estado en garantizar la preservación, en 2008 ellos crearon un grupo de protección del territorio - oficializado como Guardianes del Bosque en 2013. La actuación incomodó a grupos económicos que movían la economía local con aserraderos y carbones alimentados por madera extraída ilegalmente y generó represalias cada vez mayores.
