properties.event_description: The village was invaded by pistoleros under the control of a farmer and they fired shots and they promised "a bloodbath," and they repeated their name.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Pistoleros invadieron la aldea, bajo control de un granjero, dispararon tiros y prometieron "un baño de sangre", repitiendo el nombre de los líderes.
properties.violence_context: Since January 2016, military police have been spotted inside an estate with an intimidating posture as they have been protecting farmers. The headquarters of the farm had been fired. The information that an indigenous person entering the estate would have been reached and that gunmen were looking for the leaders had been circulated throughout. An audio confirms the strategy to avoid the resumption of traditional territories, currently overrun by farms, would be to eliminate "heads of movement."
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Desde enero de 2016, policías militares fueron vistos dentro de una hacienda con postura intimidatoria, ya que protegían a los granjeros. De la sede de la hacienda se oían tiros. Todo el tiempo circulaba la información de que el indígena que entrara en la hacienda serían alcanzado, y que pistoleros buscaban a los líderes. Un audio confirma la estrategia para evitar la reanudación de los territorios tradicionales, ahora superpuestos por las granjas, sería eliminar las "cabezas del movimiento".

properties.violence_context: The Ka'apor have been applying an autonomous plan of actions to defend their territory since 2013 as a result of violence and harassment by timber growers. The protection actions have been increasingly retaliatory.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Víctimas de violencia y acoso de madereros desde 2013 los Ka'apor pusieron en práctica un plan autónomo de acciones de defensa de su territorio. Crearon su propia guardia del bosque. Entre 2013 y 2016, los guardianes cerraron carreteras improvisadas usados por los invasores y 105 camiones que transportaban madera ilegal fueron quemados. Las acciones de protección generan represalias cada vez mayores.

properties.event_description: Two men came down from a motorcycle and called an indigenous man who was an old leader of the Pedreira village, who was living at the Buriti village. He was fired at after his call. The illegal extraction of wood from indigenous lands by a mafia of timber can be the cause of crime.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Dos hombres bajaron de una motocicleta y llamaron a un indígena quien era un antiguo lider de la Aldea Pedreira, quien estaba viviendo en la Aldea Buriti. Al atender el llamado, le dieron varios disparos. La extracción ilegal de madera de la tierra indígena por una mafia de madereros puede ser el motivo del crimen.
properties.violence_context: The Kaxarari IT are a constant target of the invasion of timber, and they illegally exploit noble wood such as ipê, angelim and muiracatiara, among others. The lack of effective measures for monitoring and protecting indigenous lands has been instrumental in encouraging the practice of new invasions by logging, mining, hoarding and illegal parceling of already demarcated lands. These practices are currently under way in several indigenous territories, including the Kaxarari IT.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): La TI Kaxarari son objetivo constante de la invasión de madereros, que explotan ilegalmente maderas nobles como ipê, angelim, muiracatiara, entre otras. La falta de medidas eficaces para la fiscalización y protección de las tierras indígenas ha servido para incentivar la práctica de nuevas invasiones de madereros, mineros, acaparadores y de parcelamiento ilegal de tierras ya demarcadas. Estas prácticas están en curso en varios territorios indígenas, incluso en el TI Kaxarari.

properties.violence_context: The 10,000 indigenous people of Araribóia have been suffering with the illegal extraction of wood, threats and violence practised by the logging industry. Faced with the State's inability to secure preservation, they established an area protection group in 2008 - officialized as Forest Guardians in 2013. The performance had been an inconvenience to economic groups that moved the local economy with steels and carbons that had been illegally extracted and had resulted in growing retaliations.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Hace años, los 10 mil indígenas de Araribóia sufren con la extracción ilegal de madera, amenazas y violencia practicada por los madereros. Frente a la incapacidad del Estado en garantizar la preservación, en 2008 ellos crearon un grupo de protección del territorio - oficializado como Guardianes del Bosque en 2013. La actuación incomodó a grupos económicos que movían la economía local con aserraderos y carbones alimentados por madera extraída ilegalmente y generó represalias cada vez mayores.

properties.event_description: At a pounding of a seawold, tipmillion, and a backguard, they attacked indigenous people, officials of Sesai and a missionary of the Cimi. While closing the village's Health Post, the group was surprised by an armed band with sticks and stones. An indigenous man broke his arm while protecting himself from attacks.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: A golpes de garrote, hacendados, poseedores y guardaespaldas atacaron a indígenas, funcionarios de Sesai y un misionero del Cimi. Mientras cerraban el Puesto de Salud de la aldea, el grupo fue sorprendido por una banda armada con palos y piedras. Un indígena se rompió el brazo al protegerse de las agresiones.
properties.violence_context: The indigenous people opened a Health Unit using the structure of an abandoned basic Health Unit in the village. The fact upset Mayor Ramón Campos Cardoso (PDT) who sees the Unit as a symbol of the establishment of the Xakriabá at the resumption of the old Fairy São Judas, he insulted the have-been against the indigenous people at an event before the attack. The territory retaken by the indigenous people was identified and delimited as traditional territory in October 2015 and since then conflicts have been tightened.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Los indígenas abrieron un Puesto de Salud aprovechando la estructura de una Unidad básica de Salud abandonada en la aldea. El hecho incomodó al alcalde Ramón Campos Cardoso (PDT) que ve la unidad como símbolo del establecimiento de los Xakriabá en la reanudación de la antigua Hacienda São Judas, él insulfló a poseedores contra los indígenas en un evento antes del ataque. El territorio retomado por los indígenas fue identificada y delimitado como territorio tradicional en octubre de 2015, y desde entonces los conflictos se han endurecido.

properties.event_description: The indigenous have been subjected to death threats as a result of his struggle and that of his people against the demarcation of their lands.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: El indígena ha sufrido amenazas de muerte por su lucha y la de su pueblo contra la demarcación de sus tierras.
properties.violence_context: Conflicts with farmers have been with them since 2007, as indigenous people have been regaining their traditional lands. The leaders have been killed and several attacks have been sustained by the community and have resulted in injuries, missing children and burned houses. The Kurussu Ambá community lives in extreme misery. Isolated by soya plantations, they cannot cultivate and the only water sources were contaminated by agrotoxic. Children die of hunger and poisonous illnesses.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Conflictos con granjeros vienen desde 2007, cuando los indígenas comenzaron a retomar sus tierras tradicionales. Desde entonces, los líderes fueron asesinados y la comunidad sufrió varios ataques, dejando heridos, niños desaparecidos y casas incendiadas. La comunidad Kurusu Ambá vive en extrema miseria. Aislados por plantaciones de soya, no pueden cultivar y las únicas fuentes de agua fueron contaminadas por agrotóxicos. Los niños mueren de hambre y de enfermedades generadas por el veneno.

properties.event_description: The victims have been constantly threatened for fighting logging on indigenous territory. Due to threats, indigenous people cannot move at the headquarters of the municipality. According to accounts, his aggressor was always armed and said that he would continue to enter indigenous territory to withdraw wood.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Las víctimas han sido constantemente amenazadas por luchar contra la explotación maderera en el territorio indígena. Por las amenazas, los indígenas no pueden transitar en la sede del municipio. Según relatos, el agresor siempre anda armado y dice que continuará entrando en el territorio indígena para retirar madera.
properties.violence_context: The indigenous people of TI Araribóia have been implementing the Guardian project. It's about fighting to put an end to the invasion of the logging companies that continue to illegally exploit the territory. With the rainy period, monitoring became more difficult and invasions increased. The situation in the region is tense, with stories of murders and confrontations at the place. In February, leaders seized two trucks that were withdrawing illegal wood and about 100 logging agents threatened to invade the area
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Los indígenas de TI Araribóia implementaron el proyecto Guardianes. En consecuencia, los motociclistas sospechosos pasaron a rondar la sede de Hutukara, preguntando por el lider.
properties.violence_context: In recent years, Hutukara has been collaborating with federal mine fight investigations, providing maps of the premises, aircraft prefixes, pilot nicknames and names of people financing illegal activity. properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): En los últimos años, Hutukara ha colaborado con las investigaciones federales de combate a la mina, proporcionando mapas de los locales, prefijos de aeronaves, apodos de pilotos y nombres de personas que financian la actividad ilegal. properties.event_description: After the indigenous people had expelled the miners and confiscated their machines, they had been threatened by a man leading a group of gunmen and had a list with five names of leaders marked to die. The indigenous people reported the mine owner and brought his delegate to his place. A document was made about the threats to register the crimes found to be of minor relevance. He was charged with illegal arms and was free after his bail.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Después de que los indígenas expulsaran a los mineros y decomisaron sus máquinas, recibieron amenazas de un hombre que lidera un grupo de pistoleros y tendría una lista con cinco nombres de líderes marcados para morir. Los indígenas denunciaron al dueño de la mina y llevaron al delegado a su casa. Sobre las amenazas se hizo un documento para registrar los crímenes considerados de menor relevancia. Él hombre fue denunciado por porte ilegal de armas y está en libertad después de pagar fianza.
properties.violence_context: There are serious conflicts in the region as a result of the Munduruku fight against dams in the Tapajós and the constant invasions of garimpeiros on their lands, leading to river pollution, fish mortality and violent conflict. Despite the denunciations, the government did not act to withdraw the invaders. In 2013, leaders denounced to the General Secretariat of the Presidency the note they call "autoreferred" and purported. "Tired of waiting, in January 2014 the indigenous people expelled tens of miners and grabbed dragons used illegally to extract gold from the Troopas River, tributary to the Tapajós River.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Hay serios conflictos en la región en función de la lucha de los Munduruku contra las represas en el Tapajós y las constantes invasiones de garimpeiros en sus tierras, que causan la contaminación de ríos, mortandad de peces y conflictos violentos. A pesar de las denuncias, el gobierno no actúa para retirar a los invasores. En el año 2013, los líderes denunciaron a la Secretaría General de la Presidencia contra la nota que llaman "autodenominadas" y pretendidas. "Cansados de esperar, en enero de 2014 los indígenas expulsaron decenas de mineros y agarraron dragas utilizadas ilegalmente para extraer oro en el río de las Tropas, afluente del río Tapajós.

properties.event_description: The logging companies interested in logging and individual Gleba parceling are encouraging violence and ethnic-racial hatred among local people. Since the conflict in October 2009, when the local community protested against an illegally exploited logging tent, journalistic work accused indigenous people of being non-true Indians, that ethnicity was already extinct, among other claims without an anthropological or legal basis.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Las empresas madereras interesadas en la explotación forestal y la parcelación individual de la Gleba, incentivan la violencia y el odio étnico-racial en la población local. Desde el conflicto ocurrido en octubre de 2009, cuando la comunidad local protestó contra un cargamento de maderas explotadas ilegalmente, los trabajos periodísticos acusan a los indígenas de no ser indios verdaderos, que la etnia ya estaba extinguida, entre otras alegaciones sin fundamento antropológico o legal.
properties.violence_context: Illegal timber put great pressure on the regularization of the ground. There are records of rights violations, criminalization and co-optation of indigenous leaders, as well as the presence of armed groups. In 2009, the local community organized a blockade at the Arapiuns River, preventing the passage of two pits with about 1,500 m3 of wood illegally extracted from the site. The episode has brought great visibility to the fight of the Borari and Arapium and their communities.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Madereros ilegales hacen gran presión contra la regularización de la tierra. Hay registros de violaciones de derechos, criminalización y cooptación de líderes indígenas, además de la presencia de grupos armados. En 2009, la comunidad local organizó un bloqueo en el río Arapiuns, impidiendo el paso de dos balsas que transportaban cerca de 1.500 m3 de madera extraída ilegalmente del sitio. El episodio ha traído gran visibilidad para la lucha de los Borari y Arapium y de las comunidades vecinas.

properties.defence_activity: Its ancestral territory from the construction of Belo Monte hydropower. They fight for indigenous rights and demand to be heard and to negotiate conditions such as building health jobs and schools at village level

properties.event_description: About 20 indigenous people were received with bombs and rubber shots by men from the National Security Forces while trying to get into the quarry of the Belo Monte plant to discuss with representatives of North Energia, who are responsible for the works. Three indigenous people were wounded.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Alrededor de 20 indígenas fueron recibidos con bombas y tiros de goma por hombres de la Fuerza Nacional de Seguridad al intentar entrar en la cantera de la planta de Belo Monte para conversar con representantes de Norte Energia, responsable de las obras. Tres indígenas resultaron heridos.
properties.violence_context: The Indians and rivers protested demand agility from North Energy in the implementation of the basic environmental plan, one of the challenges for the construction of hydropower. They blocked the TransAmazon road four days ago that gives access to the construction quarry of the Belo Monte hydropower plant, preventing the access of workers
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Indios y ribereños protestaban exigiendo agilidad del Norte Energía en la ejecución del plan básico ambiental, una de las condicionantes para la construcción de la hidroeléctrica. Bloquearon hace cuatro días la carretera Transamazónica que da acceso al cantero de obras de la central hidroeléctrica Belo Monte, impidiendo el acceso de obreros

properties.event_description: Following two years of the approval of TI Raposa Serra do Sol, preconceived statements against indigenous peoples were published in newspapers and journals claiming, inter alia, that indigenous peoples "engage in deforestation and illegal garimpo." They added that misery would be true among the peoples of the earth. Images showing indigenous people picking up garbage have been published and do not reflect their status.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Tras dos años de la homologación de TI Raposa Serra do Sol, se publicaron en periódicos y revistas declaraciones preconcebidas contra los pueblos de la tierra indígena afirmando, entre otras cosas, que los indígenas "se dedican a la deforestación y al garimpo ilegales". Añaden, además, que la miseria sería cierta entre los pueblos de la tierra. Se divulgó imágenes que muestran indígenas recogiendo basura, lo que no refleja la situación de esos pueblos.
properties.violence_context: Images from the Boa Vista dump are from people from several excluded segments, including a small group of indigenous people living in the capital who have no access to dignified survival.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Las imágenes del basurero de Boa Vista son de personas de varios segmentos excluidos, entre ellos un pequeño grupo de indígenas que, viviendo en la capital, no tienen acceso a una supervivencia digna.

properties.defence_activity: Its ancestral territory and the forest of logging and illegal mining. They fight with the construction of dams at the Tapajós and its tributaries (where most of the 13,000 mundurukus live), that would flood the territory
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su territorio ancestral y el bosque de la invasión de madereros y minería ilegal. Luchan contra la construcción de presas en el río Tapajós y sus afluentes (donde viven la mayoría de los 13.000 mundurukus), que inundarían el territorio
properties.event_description: Several local authorities, together with illegal miners deported from Munduruku land earlier this year, organized a demonstration that resulted in hostility and moral and physical violence as well as reddish shots that seriously wounded the indigenous Rosalvo Kaba and Francette Koru.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Varias autoridades del municipio, junto a mineros ilegales expulsados de la tierra Munduruku a principios de año, organizaron una manifestación que tuvo como resultado la hostilidad, la violencia moral y física, además de tiros de rojón que dejaron gravemente heridos a los indígenas Rosalvo Kaba y Francinete Koru.
properties.violence_context: In January 2014, the Munduruku conducted an operation to withdraw illegal mining from their lands. In February, the town of Jacareacanga had been dissatisfied with the role of the indigenous people with regard to hydropower stations at the Tapajós and with the deportation of the miners and had fired 70 indigenous teachers. The Munduruku protested. On the day before the demonstration of the 13th, a teacher support house was burned and the fact was attributed to the indigenous people. They deny the prosecution.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): En enero de 2014, los Munduruku realizaron operación de retirada de la minería ilegal de sus tierras. En febrero, insatisfechos con el rol de los indígenas contra las hidroeléctricas en el Tapajós y con la expulsión de los mineros, el Ayuntamiento de Jacareacanga despidió a 70 profesores indígenas. Los Munduruku protestaron. En el día anterior a la manifestación del día 13, una casa de apoyo a los profesores fue incendiada y el hecho fue atribuido a los indígenas. Ellos niegan la acusación.

properties.defence_activity: His ancestral territory, surpassing areas occupied by farms. The demarcation process has been under way for more than a century since 1904 and has been called into question by rural producers claiming to have been owned by the State itself.
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su territorio ancestral, sobreposto a areas ocupadas por granjas. El proceso de demarcación se arrastra hace más de un siglo,desde 1904, siempre cuestionado por productores rurales que alegan haber recibido la titularidad del propio Estado.
properties.event_description: The indigenous person was shot at his right leg after unidentified men, in cars and motorcycles, fired at his village and his family's house. He stated, "That's a lot of shots... they didn't come to scare but to kill me." He had surgery to get his bullet out. At the time that they were treated, trucks used by farmers and their escorts were travelling around the hospital.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: El indígena fue baleado en la pierna derecha después de que hombres no identificados, en coches y motos, atacaron a tiros la aldea y la casa donde vive con la familia. Según declaró, "fueron muchos tiros ... no vinieron para asustar, sino para matarme". Se sometió a una cirugía para extraer la bala. En el momento en que era atendido camionetas usadas por los granjeros y sus escoltas circulaban alrededor del hospital.
properties.violence_context: The indigenous area is an area of great conflict with lands and Paulino leads the resumption of Pillad Rebuá. That was the third attack suffered by the leader in less than a year. In December 2013, hooded men ignited Paulino's car, which was inside his car and was burned. The investigations have not been completed. The leader's constantly threatened and the farmers have sent a message to him, they want to "put his head out."
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El área indígena es escenario de gran conflicto de tierras y Paulino es quien lidera la reanudación Pillad Rebuá. Este fue el tercer atentado sufrido por el lider en menos de un año. En diciembre de 2013, hombres encapuchados encendieron el coche de Paulino, que estaba dentro del vehículo y sufrió quemaduras. Las investigaciones no se han finalizado. El lider se ve amenazado constantemente y los granjeros mandaron un mensaje para él, quieren"tirar su cabeza fuera".

properties.event_description: Jolinel, Josimar and others worked in the field inside the IT as they were shot at by individuals in a truck. Jolinel was killed and seriously wounded. They think the target was Lindomar, who was close. Following a great protest at the police station and at the market of the suspects, brothers José Gues and João Carlos Gues were arrested but later obtained provisional release. The proceedings have been directed at the Federal Justice Section.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Jolinel, Josimar y otros trabajaban en el campo dentro de la TI cuando fueron sorprendidos a tiros por individuos en una camioneta. Jolinel le dispararon y fue gravemente herido. Creen que el objetivo era Lindomar, que estaba cerca. Después de una gran protesta en la comisaría y frente al supermercado de los sospechosos, los hermanos José Góes y João Carlos Góes fueron arrestados, pero luego obtuvieron libertad provisional. El proceso ha sido encaminado a la Justicia Federal.
properties.violence_context: The survivors identified the car as belonging to the farmers and traders Amaral, with more than a dozen complaints about threats against leading Lindomar Terena and intimidation of the people. The Amaral brothers are supposed to own the Charquado estate retaken by the Indians two years ago. The police officers first resisted searching the case's event report and went to the brothers' property to protect them.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Los supervivientes identificaron el coche como perteneciente a los granjeros y comerciantes Amaral, objeto de más de una docena de denuncias por amenazas contra el lider Lindomar Terena e intimidaciones contra el pueblo. Los hermanos Amaral son supuestos dueños de la hacienda Charqueado retomada por los indios hace dos años. Los policías inicialmente resistirón a registrar el boletín de ocurrencia del caso y fueron a la propiedad de los hermanos para protegerlos.

We have to shoot those pines!!!!." "The man's got to do that as well???... He's barely dead."

Por ejemplo: "Parranda de vagabundos oportunistas"; "Falta meter bala en el resto rsrsrsrs"; "Tiene que pasar fuego en todos ustedes, son ladrones (sic) .Hay que fusilar esas plagas !!!!". properties.position (as given, Spanish): Liderazgo del consejo gestor ka'apor, ex-jefe de la aldea xiborendá
properties.defence_activity: He was defending the indigenous territory and forest from the logging invasion
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Defiendía el territorio indígena y el bosque de la invasión de los madereros
properties.event_description: Killed ambushed with shots fired by two unidentified gunmen as they returned home. According to the Ka'apor, those responsible for the crime are steammen from William's Center scrambled with actions by the Forest Guardians. The event report was registered by an indigenous health care nurse at Zé Doca and later modified to say that death was the result of theft. The investigations have been closed.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Asesinado en emboscada con tiros efectuados por dos pistoleros no identificados, cuando volvía a casa. Según los Ka'apor, los responsables del crimen son madereros de Centro del Guillermo revueltos con las acciones de los Guardianes del Bosque. El boletín de ocurrencia fue registrado por un enfermero de salud indígena en Zé Doca, y luego modificado para afirmar que la muerte fue fruto de robo. Las investigaciones no se concluyeron.
properties.violence_context: Since 2013, the Ka'apor have put into place an autonomous plan of actions to defend their territory, creating their own forest guard. 3. In August 2014, police officers expelled a number of logging stations, destroyed camps and burned down trucks with illicit wood. Violence against indigenous people increased after the last logging branch closed in December 2014 and several villages were invaded in retaliation by monitoring actions.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Desde 2013, los Ka'apor pusieron en práctica un plan autónomo de acciones de defensa de su territorio, creando su propia guardia del bosque. En agosto de 2014, los guardias expulsaron a varios madereros, destruyeron campamentos y quemaron los camiones que transportaban madera ilegal. La violencia contra los indígenas se intensificó tras el cierre del último ramal maderero en diciembre de 2014 y varias aldeas fueron invadidas en represalia por las acciones de fiscalización.

properties.defence_activity: Its ancestral territory, guaranteed through autodemarcation, from the miners, logging and mega-projects of hydropower at the Tapajós River - especially the UHE São Luiz do Tapajós that would flood the village Sawré Muybu.
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su territorio ancestral, garantizada a traves de la autodemarcación, de los mineros, madereros y megaproyectos de hidroeléctricas en el río Tapajós -en especial la UHE São Luiz do Tapajós que inundaría la aldea Sawré Muybu.
properties.event_description: Cacique Juárez and family leave fuel (gasoline) inside tents that were at port Bubburé while they were in town. About 200 metres from the port, the boat's motor stopped and there was a fire start. It was controlled. Upon their return to the port, they found that there was a great deal of salt mixed with gasoline in every 50-litre carot. The salt, as well as leading to an engine's bankruptcy, could have caused a huge explosion and killed everyone on board.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Cacique Juárez y familia dejaron combustible (gasolina) dentro de carpas que estaban en el puerto Buburé mientras estaban en la ciudad. A unos 200 metros del puerto, el motor del barco se paró y hubo un principio de incendio. Fue controlado. Al regresar al puerto, verificaron que había mucha sal mezclada a la gasolina en todos los carotes de 50 litros. La sal, además de provocar la quiebra del motor, podría haber causado una gran explosión y matado a todos los que estaban a bordo.
properties.violence_context: The cacique had obtained fuel to complete the autodemarcation of indigenous territory. Tired of waiting for official organs, since 2014 Muduruku have been self-demarcating their territory with maps and government documents. The aim is to approve his town's territory, which would legally sweep up the construction of the hydroelectric system of San Luis del Tapajós. Meanwhile, they face invasions and threats from logging and mining and pallumic extraction.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El cacique había conseguido combustible para concluir la autodemarcación del territorio indígena. Cansados de esperar a los órganos oficiales, desde 2014 los Muduruku realizan la autodemarcación de su territorio basada en mapas y documentos del propio gobierno. El objetivo es la homologación del territorio de su pueblo, que barraría legalmente la construcción de la Usina Hidroeléctrica de San Luis del Tapajós. Mientras tanto, sufren invasiones y amenazas de madereros, mineros y extractores de palmito.

properties.event_description: An attempt at poisoning occurred at the place where children await the school bus in the indigenous area was reported at a meeting between Funai and MPF-MT. The Funai found that the poisoned fish were left by an unidentified person near the village's gates. At the MPF uprising, no child had been fed by fish but 5 dogs from the village and wild animals had been killed with suspected intoxication.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Un intento de envenenamiento ocurrido en el lugar donde niños aguardan el autobús escolar en el área indígena fue denunciada en una reunión entre Funai y MPF-MT. La Funai constató que los peces envenenados fueron dejados, por una persona no identificada, cerca de la portera de la aldea. En el levantamiento realizado por el MPF ningún niño se alimentó de los peces, pero 5 perros de la aldea, además de animales silvestres, murieron con sospechas de intoxicación.
properties.violence_context: Projected since 1950, traditional territory remains invaded by a small non-indigenous community. The invaders illegally extracted wood, extracted gold and burned pashlands as well as fishing and hunting. Another problem faced by indigenous peoples was the use of agrotoxic products at the headquarters of rivers passing through indigenous territory.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Demarcada desde 1950, el territorio tradicional sigue invadido por una pequeña comunidad de no indígenas. Los invasores extraen ilegalmente madera, extraen oro e incendian pastizales, además de practicar la pesca y la caza ilegal. Otro problema que enfrentan los indígenas es el uso de agrotóxicos en las cabeceras de los ríos que pasan por el territorio indígena.

properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su territorio ancestral que ya había sido declarado por el Ministerio de la Justicia
properties.event_description: To enforce warrant for some people from the community, PF invaded families's homes at dawn and violently removed all people, including old people, children and women, and brought them into an area with sports. They were forced to lay with their faces on the ground for four hours. Nine people were arrested (5 indigenous men, 1 woman, 3 farmers) and brought to police station / PF and later to jail.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Para cumplir órdenes de arresto contra algunas personas de la comunidad, la PF invadió las casas de las familias de madrugada y, de forma violenta, quitó a todas las personas, incluyendo viejos, niños y mujeres, llevándolas a una espacio donde se practica deportes. Allí se vieron obligadas a quedarse acostadas con sus caras en el suelo durante cuatro horas. Nueve personas fueron detenidas (5 indígenas hombres, 1 mujer, 3 agricultores) y conducidas a la comisaría / PF y luego a la cárcel.
properties.violence_context: The prison orders against indigenous people have been determined by the Sananduva state justice system, which indicates that the orders have been at least irregular, bearing in mind that it is up to the Federal Justice to judge cases involving indigenous communities, especially as they are a conflict of lands between indigenous and farmer. According to the indigenous peoples, for several days the community was subjected to a process of intimidation and constipation.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Las ordenes de prisión contra los indígenas fueron determinadas por la justicia estatal de Sananduva, lo que evidencia que las ordenes fueron, como mínimo, irregulares, teniendo en cuenta que es de atribución de la Justicia Federal juzgar casos que involucren a comunidades indígenas, especialmente por tratarse de conflicto de tierras entre indígenas y agricultores. De acuerdo con los indígenas, durante varios días la comunidad fue sometida a un proceso de intimidación y constreñimiento.

properties.event_description: The indigenous land was affected by fire and with the cleanup of the peaks and mapezes of these areas, a group of Ka'apor agroforestry guards met with trucks, chainsaw and armed people inside the territory. Realizing the presence of indigenous people, invaders fired at the group. The indigenous people had taken refuge inside the forest and a non-indigenous logging man had been killed in the conflict. Following that event, local logging agents have been inciting to invade villages.

Los asentados pasaron a cuestionar la permanencia de los indígenas y a oponerse a la propuesta de aumentar el área indígena. properties.event_description: The victim had been killed after a gunshot to the head, allegedly by a civilian police officer during Operation Blackout. According to the Civil Police, interviewing witnesses suspect that Anderson's death is related to the ground dispute with people who call themselves owners of the occupied ground. The police say the case's been investigated by the Criminal Icelibite Abpuration Unit, which's been pounding up crimes involving police officers. Nobody's been arrested.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: La víctima murió tras ser apuntada por un disparo en la cabeza, al parecer, perpetrado por un policía civil durante la Operación Blackout. Según la Policía Civil, los testigos entrevistados sospechan que la muerte de Anderson está relacionada con la disputa de tierra con personas que se dicen dueñas del terreno en ocupación. La Policía dice que el caso es investigado por la Unidad de Apuración de Ilícitos Penales, que apura crímenes que involucra a policías. Nadie ha sido arrestado.
properties.violence_context: The "Blackout" operation involved the enforcement of an arrest warrant against the cacique Sabá Cocama, considered a fugitive from Justice. The operation involved 500 civil and military police and members of the State PM. In the occupation "Cidade das Luzes" the criminal organization "Familia do Norte" would be responsible for drug trafficking, environmental crimes and public lands invasion, according to the Secretary of Public Security of the Amazon. Eight indigenous people were arrested at the operation.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): La operación "Blackout" implicaba el cumplimiento de una orden de arresto contra el cacique Sabá Cocama, considerado prófugo de la Justicia. La operación involucró a 500 policías civiles y militares y miembros del MP estatal. En la ocupación "Cidade das Luzes" la organización criminal "Familia do Norte" sería responsable del tráfico de drogas, crímenes ambientales y invasión de tierras públicas, según la Secretaria de Seguridad Pública del Amazonas. Ocho indígenas fueron arrestados en la operación.

properties.event_description: The last time his possessor came with his drunken men to expel Mr. Ademar from his ground, his victim fired at his raft without giving them to them. The owner went up to the police station and brought police and town guard to conduct an arrest in flagrante. The next day, police returned to the place and, under the cover of a revolver, forced the woman and children to get into a boat and leave the place. The family's belongings and animals have been destroyed.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: La última vez que el poseedor llegó con sus hombres embriagados para expulsar el señor Ademar de la tierra, la víctima disparó hacia la balsa sin darle a las personas. El poseedor fue hasta la comisaría y trajo policías y guardia municipal para efectuar arresto en flagrante. Al día siguiente, la policía regresó al lugar y, bajo la mira de revólver, obligó a la mujer e hijos a entrar en un bote y abandonar el lugar. Las pertenencias y animales de la familia fueron destruidas.
properties.violence_context: Mr. Ademar refused to sell his place of residence with his family to an indigenous person. He came to occupy the area after the titling of the ground, and has been devolving to rent his grazing to other farmers from the region that give him support. On one occasion, the possessor tried to invade Mr.'s float Also with men with machetes that threw their kitchen tools into the river. The victim stopped them with a gun.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El Sr. Ademar rechazó vender el lugar donde residía con la familia a un poseedor que reside en la territorio indígena. Él pasó a ocupar el área después de la delimitación de la tierra, y viene deforestando para alquilar el pastoreo a otros granjeros de la región que le dan apoyo. En una ocasión, el poseedor intentó invadir el flotante del Sr. Ademar con hombres armados con machetes que arrojaron los utensilios de cocina en el río. La víctima los detuvo apuntando un arma.

properties.event_description: Cacique Juárez and family leave fuel (gasoline) inside the containers that were at port Bubburé while they were in town. About 200 metres from the port, the boat's motor stopped and there was a fire start. It was controlled. Upon their return to port, they found that there was a great deal of salt mixed with gasoline in all 50-litre containers. The salt, as well as leading to an engine's bankruptcy, could have caused a huge explosion and killed everyone on board.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Cacique Juárez y familia dejaron combustible (gasolina) dentro de los recipientes que estaban en el puerto Buburé mientras estaban en la ciudad. A unos 200 metros del puerto, el motor del barco se paró y hubo un principio de incendio. Fue controlado. Al regresar al puerto, verificaron que había mucha sal mezclada a la gasolina en todos los recipientes de 50 litros. La sal, además de provocar la quiebra del motor, podría haber causado una gran explosión y matado a todos los que estaban a bordo.
properties.violence_context: The cacique had obtained fuel to complete the autodemarcation of indigenous territory. Tired of waiting for official organs, since 2014 Muduruku have been self-demarcating their territory with maps and government documents. The aim is to approve his town's territory, which would legally sweep up the construction of the hydroelectric system of San Luis del Tapajós. Meanwhile, they face invasions and threats from logging and mining and pallumic extraction.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El cacique había conseguido combustible para concluir la autodemarcación del territorio indígena. Cansados de esperar a los órganos oficiales, desde 2014 los Muduruku realizan la autodemarcación de su territorio basada en mapas y documentos del propio gobierno. El objetivo es la homologación del territorio de su pueblo, que barraría legalmente la construcción de la Usina Hidroeléctrica de San Luis del Tapajós. Mientras tanto, sufren invasiones y amenazas de madereros, mineros y extractores de palmito.

Following a great protest at the police station and at the market of the suspects, brothers José Gues and João Carlos Gues were arrested but later obtained provisional release. The Amaral brothers are supposed to own the Charquado estate retaken by the Indians two years ago. The police officers first resisted searching the case's event report and went to the brothers' property to protect them.

properties.event_description: Simeon's body was found at the edge of a stream with his face drilled by a bullet of fire during an attack by about 100 farmers to the area that had been resumed a week earlier by the indigenous people. The criminal action for death was still put forward in 2015 but the criminal complaint was only received by the judge in 2018.

properties.event_description: Cacique Juárez and family leave fuel (gasoline) inside the containers that were at port Bubburé while they were in town. About 200 metres from the port, the boat's motor stopped and there was a fire start. It was controlled. Upon their return to port, they found that there was a great deal of salt mixed with gasoline in all 50-litre containers. The salt, as well as leading to an engine's bankruptcy, could have caused a huge explosion and killed everyone on board.

Al regresar al puerto, verificaron que había mucha sal mezclada a la gasolina en todos los recipientes de 50 litros. La sal, además de provocar la quiebra del motor, podría haber causado una gran explosión y matado a todos los que estaban a bordo.
properties.violence_context: The cacique had obtained fuel to complete the autodemarcation of indigenous territory. Meanwhile, they face invasions and threats from logging and mining and pallumic extraction.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El cacique había conseguido combustible para concluir la autodemarcación del territorio indígena. properties.event_description: In answering a question about land demarcations in general and particularly at Mato Grosso del Sur and Roraima, then federal deputy Jair Bolsonaro made prethought statements against Indians. Among other pitiful phrases, he said "Indian doesn't speak our tongue, doesn't have money,'s a poor poor man, has to be integrated into society, not created into billionaire zoos."
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Al responder a una pregunta sobre demarcaciones de tierras en general y, particularmente, en Mato Grosso del Sur y en Roraima, el entonces diputado federal Jair Bolsonaro hizo declaraciones preconcebidas contra los indios. Entre otras frases despectivas, él dijo "indio no habla nuestra lengua, no tiene dinero, es un pobre pobre, tiene que ser integrado a la sociedad, no creado en zoológicos millonarios".
properties.violence_context: The then federal deputy (since 2019, president of Brazil) was being honored at the headquarters of the General Command of Military police, in Campo Grande (MS), while criticizing indigenous lands demarcations. Citing as an example Dourados and the Raposa Serra do Sol Indigenous Reserve, she said that the denunciations were economically killing the states, in the case of Roraima a a state that had niobium but could not be exploited because of indigenous territory.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El entonces diputado federal (desde 2019, presidente de Brasil), estaba siendo homenajeado en la sede del Comando General de la Policía Militar, en Campo Grande (MS), cuando criticó las demarcaciones de tierras indígenas. Citando como ejemplo Dourados y la Reserva Indígena Raposa Serra do Sol, dijo que las demarcaciones estaban matando económicamente a los estados, en el caso de Roraima un estado que tiene niobio pero no podría ser explotado a causa del territorio indígena.

He said that if they continued, he would come and talk about them and come and figure something out.

Quería saber quién estaba detrás del servicio y no le gustó cuando Juárez explicó que son los propios indígenas. Dijo que si continuaban él no venía más a hablar, que venía a resolver de cualquier manera.
properties.violence_context: Tired of waiting for official organs, since 2014 the Muduruku have been self-demarcating their territory within the limits established by Funai in the land identification report. The aim was to approve the territory, which would legally prohibit the construction of the hydroelectric system of São Luis do Tapajós. Meanwhile, they face invasions and threats from logging and mining and pallumic extraction. Juárez, leading the conduct of autodemarcation, has been with several threats and murder attempts since.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Cansados de esperar a los órganos oficiales, desde 2014 los Muduruku realizan la autodemarcación de su territorio dentro de los límites fijados por la Funai en el informe de identificación de la tierra. properties.event_description: Killed at the Múda Retiro Múda quilombo, according to community residents, by 3 police officers without a cape (Company of Special actions of the Atlantic Kill). The police invaded Diogo's house and a 15-year-old was abally trying to get close. The body was taken with a car to the neighboring town of Nova Viçosa, where there are reports of drug trafficking. The event paper stated that the boy was a drug dealer and that he died after an exchange of shots with police officers with a "mouth of smoke."
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Asesinado en el Quilombo de Vuelta Miúda, según residentes de la comunidad, por 3 policías sin uniforme de la Caema (Compañía de Acciones Especiales de la Mata Atlántica). Los policías invadieron la casa de Diogo y un joven de 15 años fue abaliado al intentar acercarse. El cuerpo fue llevado en un vehículo al municipio vecino de Nova Viçosa, donde hay denuncias de tráfico de drogas. En el boletín de ocurrencia hicieron constar que el muchacho era traficante y que murió tras el intercambio de disparos con policías en "boca de humo".
properties.violence_context: The community states that it suffers threats from police and production companies of eucalyptus that have an interest in the area. Diogo was making eucalyptus companies uncomfortable about production of coal for his family's survival.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): La comunidad declara que sufre amenazas de policías y empresas productoras de eucalipto, que tienen interés en el área. Diogo incomodaba a empresas de eucalipto por producir carbón para la subsistencia de su familia.

The Incra made its initial technical award but negotiations have been paralysed for more than three years.

El Incra realizó el laudo técnico inicial, pero las negociaciones están paralizadas desde hace más de tres años.

properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Asesinado con un tiro en la cabeza mientras trabajaba en su taller mecánico. Juan denunciaba el acaparamiento de tierras y la extracción ilegal de madera por un consorcio en la región. Ya había registrado varios boletines de ocurrencia en la Policía Federal debido a las amenazas de muerte que recibía.
properties.violence_context: The Institute Chico Mendes de Conservación de la Biodiversidad (ICMBio), with support from the Federal Police, National Guard and Military, conducted an operation to figure out how to get some land and how to get some illegal wood. The operation did, however, have no continuity as a result of a lack of safety for environmental agents. Two days before his murder, Chupel detailed the wood retirement scheme (Ipê), with PA Areia as his entrance door, for the MPF at Altamira.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El Instituto Chico Mendes de Conservación de la Biodiversidad (ICMBio) realizó, con apoyo de la Policía Federal, Guardia Nacional y Ejército, una operación para averiguar el acaparamiento de tierras y la extracción ilegal de madera. Sin embargo, la operación no tuvo continuidad por falta de seguridad para los agentes ambientales. Dos días antes del asesinato, Chupel detalló el esquema de retirada de madera (Ipê), que tiene como puerta de entrada el PA Areia, para el MPF en Altamira.

La hermana de Delmir dejó la comunidad porque Bebeto había prohibido a su marido, ya fallecido, cuidar su cultivo.

They were members of the National Council of Extractivist Populations, NGOs founded by Chico Mendes and fought for forest preservation in the Amazon and production in a sustainable way.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): La pareja de extractivistas era amenazada de muerte por los madereros y los carboneros de la región que invaden el área de dicho Proyecto de Asentamiento en busca de maderas nobles. Ellos eran integrantes del Consejo Nacional de Poblaciones extractivistas, ONG fundada por Chico Mendes y luchaban por la preservación de los bosques en la Amazonia y producción de forma sostenible.

properties.violence_context: Born in Toulon, the French biologist arrived in Brazil in 1963. He was specialized in the study of butterflies from the region and had a scientific collection. He married a Brazilian and lived at Santo Antônio do Tauá in 1976. According to his son, Jacques Jauffret, who's also a biologist, his father and his father were suffering death threats more than a year ago because of his attempts to avoid deforestation and environmental degradation in the area. "They called and said," I'm gonna kill you, you old man. "
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Nacido en Toulon, el biólogo francés llegó a Brasil en 1963. Era especializado en el estudio de mariposas de la región, de las cuales tenía una colección científica. Se casó con una brasileña y vivió en Santo Antônio do Tauá en 1976. Según el hijo Jacques Jauffret, quien también es biólogo, él y su padre venían sufriendo amenazas de muerte hace más de un año, por sus intentos de evitar la deforestación y la degradación ambiental en el área. "Llamaban diciendo: 'Te voy a matar, viejo safado".

properties.event_description: Rider was killed with 19 shots on his way home at Cleiro do Norte (EC). In June 2012, Justice accepted the PM's complaint against the owner and manager of the region's fruit production company, accused of intellectual conduct of crime, and two other suspected crime (1 was killed in 2010). In 2015, the Justice sentenced them to three by means of a popular jury. In March 2017, both suspected authors were exonerated by the jury and the suspected material perpetrator of the crime still expects the designation of the popular jury.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Lider en la región, fue asesinado con 19 tiros en el camino a casa, en Limoeiro do Norte (CE). En junio de 2012, la Justicia aceptó la denuncia del MP contra el propietario y el gerente de la empresa de fruticultura de la región, acusados de autoría intelectual del crimen, y otros dos sospechos de perpetrar el crimen (1 de ellos fue asesinado en 2010). En 2015, la Justicia sentenció a los tres por medio de jurado popular. En marzo de 2017, los dos sospechos de autoría fueron exonerados por el jurado y el sospecho autor material del crimen aún espera la designación del jurado popular.
properties.violence_context: He reported violations of human rights throughout the Jaguaribe Valley and public demonstrations, especially water pollution through the use of agrotoxic products. Since 2009, she had been undergoing death threats.

properties.person_or_organization_name: Antônio Moreira Da Cruz, "Chapéu De Couro"
properties.ethnic_community: Does not identify with an ethnic community
properties.defence_activity: The right to land, fighting with logging and other headquarters that negotiated with logging and wanted to expel families from the settlement
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): El derecho a la tierra, luchando contra los madereros y otros asentados que negociaban con los madereros y querían expulsar las familias del asentamiento
properties.event_description: Between September 17 and 18, eight workers were killed in a conflict involving, on the one hand, the settlement leaders who negotiated with logging with timber and, on the other, a group of 70 families that was pressurized by Incra and government leaders to leave the area where they had been located by Incra itself, under the allegation that they were a statutory settlement reserve. The area, occupied by them, was being exploited by timber.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Entre 17 y 18 de septiembre, ocho trabajadores fueron asesinados en un conflicto que involucraba, por un lado, a los líderes del asentamiento que negociaban con madereros la extracción de madera, y de otro, un grupo de 70 familias que era presionadas por el Incra y los dirigentes del gobierno a dejar el área en que habían sido ubicados por el mismo Incra, bajo el alegato de tratarse de reserva legal de asentamiento. El área, por ellos ocupada, estaba siendo explotada por madereros.
properties.violence_context: The settlement was established by Incra on Union lands and established in 2005. The area, according to Ibama with more than 76.5 thousand hectares of native Amazon forest and close to Tucumruí's sawmills, is coveted by logging. In 2007, the press reported that some tens of families have been deported by timber-related criminals. Those who returned were dominated by fear. Since 2008, the NPC of Anapu and Tucumruí have been receiving complaints from inhabitants about their abandonment.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El asentamiento fue creado por el Incra en tierras de la Unión e implantado en 2005. El área, según el Ibama con más de 76,5 mil hectáreas de bosque nativo amazónico y próximo a aserraderos de Tucuruí, es codiciada por las madereras. En 2007, la prensa informó que criminales vinculados a madereros expulsaron a decenas de familias. Las que regresaron vivían dominadas por el miedo. Desde 2008, las CPT de Anapu y Tucuruí vienen recibiendo denuncias de habitantes sobre el abandono en que viven.

properties.position: Founding of moquibom, president of the association
properties.position (as given, Spanish): Fundador del moquibom, presidente de la asociación
properties.defence_activity: Their ancestral territory of farmers claiming that their lands are their property. Until 2008, farmers were picking up most of the community's production of agriculture, and Flavio faced them and free them from demand.
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su territorio ancestral de granjeros que afirmaban que las tierras son su propiedad.Hasta 2008, los granjeros recogían la mayor parte de la producción agrícola de la comunidad, Flaviano los enfrentó, liberándolos de la exigencia
properties.event_description: Killed for leading families in resistance and fight for recognition of the territory of the Quilombola Charco Community, where they lived more than 100 years ago. In 2018, former military police officer Joshua Sobre Saboia was convicted as an intermediary for his murder. According to the investigation, Saboia attracted Flavio to the bar where Irismar Pereira fired seven shots at his victim's head. The perpetrator died in prison in 2013.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Asesinado por liderar a las familias en la resistencia y lucha por el reconocimiento del territorio de la Comunidad Quilombola Charco, donde vivían hace más de 100 años. En 2018, el ex policía militar Josuel Sodré Sabóia fue condenado como intermediario del asesinato. Según la investigación, Sabóia atrajo a Flaviano para el bar donde Irismar Pereira disparó siete tiros en la cabeza de la víctima. El perpetrador murió en la prisión en 2013.
properties.violence_context: The family of the merchant and farmer Gentil Gomes had been charged with an action to re-integrate possession against families of the community. The Public Prosecutor's Office accused the brothers and sisters of Jesus Martins Gomes and Antônio Martins Gomes of their crime. In 2014, they were sentenced to a popular jury. On set / 2015, however, they were exonerated from the Jury and found innocent under the argument of lack of evidence that they had hired Saboia to commit the crime.

properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El área es lugar de conflicto porque a pesar de ser reconocida y tener su territorio delimitado, el Estado no promovió ninguna acción para la retirada de terceros del área. properties.person_or_organization_name: Flávio Gabriel Pacífico Dos Santos, "Binho Do Quilombo"
properties.defence_activity: The title of Afro _ quilombola territory. He also denouncing the installation of a sanitary pilling that will compromise the San Sebastian aquifer and will promote the devastation of an environmental protection area in the municipality of Simões Filho.
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): La titulación del territorio afro_quilombola. También denunciaba la instalación de un relleno sanitario que comprometerá el acuífero San Sebastián y promoverá la devastación de área de protección ambiental en el municipio de Simões Filho.
properties.event_description: Killed with 10 shots. He was under threat of death as a result of his actions to uphold the rights of the quilombola communities, especially that of Pitanga dos Palmares, where he lived.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Asesinada con 10 tiros. Estaba amenazada de muerte a causa de su actuación en pro de los derechos de las comunidades quilombolas, principalmente la de Pitanga dos Palmares, lugar en que vivía.
properties.violence_context: Pitanga dos Palmares is an area coveted by real estate constructions. Today, with other leaders, Flávio acted on three fronts: against the bastural that's been built at Simões Filho, as a result of the non-payment of tolls put up close to his living community (Pitanga dos Palmares) and against invasions in quilombola territories by large industries.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Pitanga dos Palmares es un área codiciada por las construcciones inmobiliarios. En la actualidad, junto a otros líderes, Flávio actuaba en tres frentes: contra el basural que está siendo construido en Simões Filho, por el no pago de peaje instalado cerca de la comunidad en que residía (Pitanga dos Palmares) y contra las invasiones en los territorios quilombolas por parte de grandes industrias.

properties.event_description: Flávio, Marinalva and Jairo disappeared at Igarapé Araras as they did batch collection at the town with the aim of sending data to Inrea for the regularization of the area. The searches for the victims by the State were suspended without success on 24 December 2017. On 31 December of that year, justice ordered the pretrial detention of Antônio Mijoler Garcia Filho and Rinaldo da Silva Mota, both from Shalom and suspected of crime.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Flávio, Marinalva y Jairo desaparecieron en el Igarapé Araras cuando hacían levantamiento de lotes en la localidad con el objetivo de enviar los datos al Incra para el proceso de regularización del área. Las búsquedas de las víctimas por el Estado fueron suspendidas sin éxito el día 24 de diciembre de 2017. El 31 de diciembre de ese año, la justicia decretó la detención preventiva de Antônio Mijoler Garcia Filho y Rinaldo da Silva Mota, ambos de la hacienda Shalom y sospechosos por los crímenes.

properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su territorio contra la invasión de madereros
properties.event_description: Altamiro and Joshua, father and son respectively, were killed electrocuted at the Ramal Holy Land. That was a typically criminal event, as deaths were caused by an underground energy network, established for several years by a local logging company.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Altamiro y Josué, padre e hijo respectivamente, murieron electrocutados en el Ramal Tierra Santa. Se trata de un acontecimiento típicamente delictivo, pues las muertes son causadas por una red clandestina de energía, instalada desde hace varios años por un maderero de la región.
properties.violence_context: Since 2008, the logging industry has been threatening families of the Holy Land Community and destroying their homes and preventing them from benefiting from the light for all program and from seizing the forest. The Association communautaire tierra Santa has been denouncing the conflict for some time with public agencies at the federal, state and municipal level and indicates that they have been chased by the illegal activities of that logging place. To date, however, nothing had been done to solve the problem.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Desde 2008, el maderero amenaza a las familias de la Comunidad Tierra Santa, destruye sus casas, impide que sean beneficiadas por el programa Luz para Todos y depreda el bosque. La Asociación Comunitaria Tierra Santa denuncia el conflicto desde hace tiempo a los organismos públicos federales, estatales y municipales, y manifiesta que es perseguida por las actividades ilegales de dicho maderero. Sin embargo, hasta el momento no se ha hecho nada para solucionar el problema.

properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Su territorio tradicional de la especulación imobiliária por empresas de empreendimentos turísticos
properties.event_description: Killed by a shot at his own residence. He had been fighting for his families to stay with his families and his families in the community of Trendade and had been threatened with his retirement by entrepreneurs of tourism projects. Two police officers, who were at the service of a company that operates in the region on their day of rest, are suspected of crime and are responded to justice - and released - for manslaughter. According to information from the community, both have returned to police activity at Paraty and one of them threatened his families.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Asesinado por un tiro en su propia residencia. Luchaba por la permanencia de las familias caiçara en la comunidad de Trindade amenazadas con ser expulsadas por empresarios de emprendimientos turísticos. Dos policías militares, que el día del descanso estaban al servicio de una empresa que actúa en la región, son sospechosos del crimen y responden ante la justicia -en libertad- por homicidio calificado. Según información de la comunidad, los dos han vuelto a la actividad de policía en Paraty y uno de ellos amenazó a familiares de la victíma.
properties.violence_context: The community of Trendade is superimposed to two conservation units, the Sierra de Bocaina National Park and the Environmental Protection Area (APA) of Cairuçu in Parati. Since the 1970s, the traditional fishermen community has been with their lands threatened by real estate interests. The corporate group for whom police were providing security claims ownership and tries to expel the traditional community from the area.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): La comunidad de Trindade está superpuesta a dos unidades de conservación, el Parque Nacional de la Sierra de Bocaina y Área de Protección Ambiental (APA) del Cairuçu en Parati. Desde la década de los 70, la comunidad tradicional de pescadores viene teniendo sus tierras amenazadas por intereses inmobiliarios. El grupo empresarial para quien los policías prestaban seguridad reivindica la propiedad de la tierra e intenta expulsar a la comunidad tradicional del área.

properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Actuaba en una operación contra la extracción ilegal de madera en la Amazonía, en la Flona Jamanxim
properties.event_description: Killed in an ambush at Flona do Jamanxim national forest, while accompanying Ibama agents at Operation Green Wave, that fight illegal logging in areas of the Amazon. Hours before crime, the team had dismantled a clandestine camp used for illegal deforestation in the region. In retaliation for that action, hours later people were ambushed and gunned. Juan Luiz was reached and killed. The crime's been investigated by the Federal police.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Asesinado en una emboscada en el bosque nacional Flona do Jamanxim, cuando acompañaba a agentes del Ibama en la Operación Ola Verde, que combate la explotación ilegal de madera en áreas de la Amazonia. Horas antes del crimen, el equipo había desmontado un campamento clandestino usado para la deforestación ilegal en la región. En represalia a esa acción, horas más tarde las personas fueron emboscados y atacadas a tiros. Juan Luiz fue alcanzado y murió. El crimen está siendo investigado por la Policía Federal.
properties.violence_context: Established in 2006, Flona do Jamanxim national forest is situated at the centre of BR-163, which cuts the whole state of Pará. The region is one of the most critical areas of deforestation in the Amazon.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Creado en 2006, el bosque nacional Flona do Jamanxim está ubicado en el eje de la BR-163, que corta todo el estado de Pará. La región es una de las áreas más críticas de la deforestación en la Amazonia.

properties.violence_context: Many years ago families of the Charco Community suffered violence as a result of the fight for the right to land. In 2010, Flavio Pinto Neto was killed with seven gunshots to his head. Another leader was accompanied by the National Forces for a year. The community was always threatened, especially after it stopped delivering more than half its production to the local farmer.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Hace años, las familias de la Comunidad Charco sufren violencias a causa de la lucha por el derecho a la tierra. En 2010, Flaviano Pinto Neto fue asesinado con siete tiros de pistola en la cabeza. Otro lider estuvo acompañado por la Fuerza Nacional durante un año. La comunidad siempre sufrió amenazas, principalmente cuando dejó de entregar más de la mitad de su producción al granjero de la región.

properties.event_description: The care suffered by a group of residents during the re-establishment of the area of Km 19 of Maçaranduba / Alto Acará. The shots came from an unknown man, Abiair Amaral Gusmao and Jocivani Amaral Gusmao brothers were killed and there was an attempt at murder of three other members of the community (Jaciane, Salabi and Júnior). The associations reported that "Instead of the crime perpetrator, families of the victims, who are also from the community, have been arrested."
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Atentado sufrido por un grupo de residentes durante el proceso de reanudación del área del Km 19 de Maçaranduba / Alto Acará. Los disparos provenieron de un desconocido, los hermanos Abiair Amaral Gusmao y Josivani Amaral Gusmao fueron asesinados y hubo un intento de homicidio de otros tres integrantes de la comunidad (Jaciane, Sueli y Júnior). Las asociaciones denunciaron que "en lugar del autor del crimen, los familiares de las víctimas, que también son de la comunidad, fueron arrestados".
properties.violence_context: The conflict area is in possession of the company Biovale, owned by Vale SA. According to families' account, the conflict is with people interested in selling quilombola lands for the biopsma, an intermediary company that plants palm for the biopvale.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): El área en conflicto está en posesión de la empresa Biovale, propiedad de la Vale SA. properties.violence_context: Since 2012, Raimundo had been denouncing illegal logging in the region of the pindaré and had been killed for defending forest preservation. In March 2016, the PF presensively arrested two persons (father and son) suspected of being the perpetrators of the crime. A month later, the measures were revoked and they are currently responding for the crime at liberty / house arrest. According to the report of the CPT / 2016, Maria da Conceição has also been threatened in 06 / 04 / 2016.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Desde 2012, Raimundo denunciaba a madereros ilegales en la región del Valle del Pindaré y recibió amenazas de muerte por defender la preservación del bosque. En marzo de 2016, la PF arrestó preventivamente a dos hacendados (padre e hijo) sospechosos de ser los autores del crimen. Un mes después, las medidas fueron revocadas y ahora ellos responden por el crimen en libertad/arresto domiciliario. Según el Informe de la CPT/2016, Maria da Conceição tambien ha sido amenazada en 06/04/2016.

properties.defence_activity: The right to and sustainable use of land. Leader of three sustainable development project (SDP) settlements in the TransAmazon region: pDS Castanheira, pDS Avelino Ribeiro, pDS Arthur Faleiro. He fought for the regularization of the land with the National Institute of Colonization and Agrarian Reform (INCRA), against the interests of the grileiros of the region.
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): El derecho a la tierra y su uso sostenible. Líder de tres asentamientos del Proyecto de Desarrollo Sostenible (SDP) en la región de Transamazónica: PDS Castanheira, PDS Avelino Ribeiro, PDS Arthur Faleiro. Luchó por la regularización de la tierra con el Instituto Nacional de Colonización y Reforma Agraria (INCRA), en contra de los intereses de los grileiros de la región.
properties.event_description: Killed by shots at his house's door, situated in the Alvorada neighborhood of Rurópoles, by two men who arrived on a motorcycle. He was rescued and taken to the town hospital but was unable to resist his injuries and died.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Asesinado por disparos en la puerta de su casa, situada en el barrio de Alvorada en Rurópolis, por dos hombres que llegaron en una motocicleta. Fue rescatado y llevado al hospital de la ciudad, pero no pudo resistir sus heridas y murió.
properties.violence_context: He was president of the Association of Farmers of the New Alliance, representing the three GFPs, with about 600 families living in a precarious manner, pending an INCRA decision about the regularization of the land. Due to his militancy, he was threatened by gunmen, leading him to move to Rurópolis a year ago, for fear of family safety. According to the report of the CPT / 2018, she suffered a death threat on 31 / 01 / 2018.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Fue presidente de la Asociación de Agricultores de la Nueva Alianza, que representa a los tres PDS, en la que viven unas 600 familias de forma precaria, en espera de una decisión del INCRA sobre la regularización de la tierra. Debido a su militancia, fue amenazado por pistoleros, lo que le motivó a mudarse a Rurópolis hace un año, por temor a la seguridad de la familia. Según el informe del CPT/2018, sufrió una amenaza de muerte el 31/01/2018.

properties.defence_activity: Human rights defenders investigate violations of indigenous rights in that Amazon region. There are serious conflicts as a result of the presence of soybean producers in the traditional territories of Munduruku
properties.defence_activity (as published, Spanish): Defensores de los derechos humanos,investigavan las violaciones de los derechos indígenas en esa región amazonica.Allí hay graves conflictos como consecuencia de la presencia de productores de soja en el territoritorio tradicional Munduruku
properties.event_description: Representatives of the IACHR were intimidated by soybean producers while visiting Açaizal village for a meeting at which the indigenous people would be heard. The tour was followed by two scuba trucks that insisted on participating in the meeting only for indigenous leaders. Racist and violent speeches have been pronounced against those present and they have been trying to get the plates of the vehicles that have been brought to them. They leave the place after interpelled by police.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Representantes de la CIDH fueron intimidados por productores de soja mientras visitaban la aldea Açaizal para una reunión en la que sería escuchado el pueblo indígena. La comitiva fue seguida por dos camionetas con sojeros que insistían en participar en la reunión sólo para líderes indígenas. Se pronunciaron discursos racistas y violentos contra los presentes e intentaron tomar las placas de los vehículos que llevaron a los participantes. Dejarón el local después de interpelados por la policía.
properties.violence_context: The IACHR documented the following violations of human rights: an action of agronegoctio and of the great projects that have been undertaken to put an end to the indigenous peoples, quilombas and their territories and to the settlements of agrarian reform, biodiversity and waters, with an emphasis on the purported construction of the Port of Maicá, to be destined for the flow of the grains.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): La CIDH documentó las siguientes violaciones a los derechos humanos: actuación del agronegocio y de los grandes emprendimientos en desrespecho a los pueblos indígenas, quilombolas, ribereños y sus territorios, a los asentamientos de reforma agraria, a la biodiversidad y a las aguas, con destaque para la pretendida construcción del Puerto del Maicá, a ser destinado para el flujo de los granos.

properties.event_description: The old man, about 70, was beaten to death as a result of an attack by the Military Police. In addition to Querino, another man received more than 10 shots of a rubber bullet and a boy was wounded in his leg by a lethal bullet. According to testimony to the MPF, indigenous people also suffered constipations and insults as "dirty Indian troops."
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: El anciano, aproximadamente 70 años, fue golpeado hasta desmayarse producto de un ataque de la Policía Militar. Además de Querino, otro señor recibió más de 10 tiros de bala de goma y un chico resultó herido en la pierna por disparo de bala letal. De acuerdo con testimonio prestado al MPF, los indígenas también sufrieron constreñimientos e insultos, como "tropa de indios sucios".
properties.violence_context: In recent years, the Kaingangs have decided to occupy an area of INNIT's dominion, and so as a federal area, as a means of drawing the attention of the federal authorities to the need for demarcation of their lands. Hours later, they were surprised with the arrival of more than 30 police from the Military Brigade and Special Operations Battalion (BOE) ordering them to leave the area. They would have been trying to engage with police but the initiative had been unsuccessful and they had been assaulted.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): En los últimos años, los Kaingang decidieron ocupar un área de dominio del DNIT, por lo tanto, área federal, como forma de llamar la atención de las autoridades federales para la necesidad de demarcación de sus tierras. Horas después, fueron sorprendidos con la llegada de más de 30 policías de la Brigada Militar y del Batallón de Operaciones Especiales (BOE) ordenando que salieran del área. Habrían intentado diálogo con los policías pero la iniciativa no surtió efecto y fueron agredidos.

properties.event_description: He was a victim of an attack after a meeting at FUNAI headquarters in Guaíra. He was fired from his back by an individual in a dark car. The motive and complainant were neither clarified nor released by police. The indigenous will stay paraplegic. That attack was reported to the IACHR during his visit to Brazil.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: Fue víctima de un ataque al salir de una reunión en la sede de la FUNAI en Guaíra. Fue disparado por la espalda por un individuo en un vehículo oscuro. El motivo y el autor no fueron aclarados ni liberados por la policía. El indígena se quedará parapléjico. Este ataque fue denunciado a la CIDH (Comisión Interamericana de Derechos Humanos), durante su visita a Brasil.
properties.violence_context: According to the Tekoha Y'Hovy Cacique, the scene of violence against indigenous people in Guaíra has been emphasized since 2012 with constant threats, racism, violence with a gun and other attacks. Following a truce in 2017, the attacks again occurred with the disclosure of a report of delimitation of indigenous territory, issued by Funai. The day after the attack by Donecildo, TRF4 suspended the demarcation of the Avá-Guaraní lands at Guaíra and Tierra Roxy.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Según el Cacique del Tekoha Y'Hovy, el escenario de violencia contra los indígenas en Guaíra se acentuó desde 2012 con constantes amenazas, racismo, violencia con arma de fuego, y otras agresiones. Después de una tregua en 2017, las agresiones volvieron a darse con la divulgación de un informe de delimitación del territorio indígena, emitido por la Funai. Al día siguiente del atentado de Donecildo, el TRF-4 suspendió el proceso de demarcación de las tierras Avá-Guaraní en Guaíra y Tierra Roxa.

properties.event_description: The leadership suffered an attack in front of his house. It was approached by a neighbor, questioning her about the payment of a retirement fence during a community mutiron to give access to the Santa Rosa slate. After Francesca reported that the decision was made by the community and that any damage was charged at Justice, his neighbor's husband came after and had been put with a knife. Francanca stood up as she could and got safarsey and run with his sister on a bike.
properties.event_description (as published, Spanish: La lideresa sufrió un atentando frente a su casa. Fue abordada por una vecina, cuestionándola sobre el pago de una cerca retirada durante mutirón comunitario para dar acceso al azud Santa Rosa. Después de que Francisca informara que la decisión fue tomada por la comunidad y que cualquier daño fuera cobrado en la Justicia, el esposo de la vecina vino detrás y armado con un cuchillo. Francisca se defendió como pudo y consiguió safarsey y huir con su hermana en una moto.
properties.violence_context: The threats began in 2017, when the community was organized and rebuilt a natural water source, the Santa Rosa dam, destroyed by the farmer of the region. During the community mutiron, the couple of neighbours (supported by what they say owns) threatened the group several times. The azud was completely rebuilt and after full served more than 20 communities.
properties.violence_context (as published, Spanish): Las amenazas comenzaron en 2017, cuando la comunidad se organizó y reconstruyó una fuente natural de agua, la represa Santa Rosa, destruida por el granjero de la región. Durante el mutirón comunitario, la pareja de vecinos (apoyados por lo que se dice dueño de la tierra) amenazó varias veces al grupo. El azud fue totalmente reconstruido y después de lleno sirvió a más de 20 comunidades.
